It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

</details>


### [163] [Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33077)
*Adham M. Alkhadrawi,Mohammed A. B. Mahmoud*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 深度可分离分解在3D中的参数量增长远小于稠密卷积，据此构建的3D U-Net仅用536,990参数（比同结构稠密3D U-Net少24倍），在MSD Task03 Liver上肝脏Dice 0.947、肿瘤Dice 0.577，优于既往报告结果，并在同条件对照中超过稠密3D U-Net。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三维稠密卷积网络在体积医学图像分割中性能最强，但参数量随卷积核维度增长呈立方级膨胀：k×k卷积扩展到k×k×k时权重乘以k。作者希望在不牺牲精度的前提下构建极轻量的3D分割网络，以适配医学影像小数据、高维度的场景。

Method: 作者观察到深度可分离分解不具备这一参数量惩罚：立方核项仅作用于depthwise阶段，而占参数主体的pointwise投影不变，因此同一架构从2D到3D仅增长5%（稠密卷积U-Net增长200%）。基于该不对称性设计了一个含536,990参数的3D U-Net。在MSD Task03 Liver（源自LiTS）上对全部131例公开体积做五折交叉验证、逐例评估，并与同条件训练的稠密3D U-Net在共同留出划分上对比；此外在LiTS与一个2D内窥镜基准上，用固定位移替换部分可学习空间滤波器进行消融。

Result: 肿瘤Dice 0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice 0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]）。肝脏Dice超过既往报告性能；肿瘤Dice比其低分辨率配置（0.4701）高0.107、比其2D配置（0.5394）高，而参数量约为其1/24、平面分辨率约为其一半。相同条件下在共同留出划分上，肝脏Dice较稠密3D U-Net高+0.031（配对p=0.006），肿瘤高+0.041（95% CI [+0.005, +0.081]，配对p=0.056）。消融显示大量可学习空间滤波器可被固定位移替换而不损失精度，但全部替换则明显变差。

Conclusion: 深度可分离分解使3D网络参数量近似与2D持平，可作为正则化手段在小数据医学影像场景中带来增益；空间容量的"放置位置"比其"总量"更关键——固定位移可替代部分但非全部可学习滤波器。

Abstract: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

</details>


### [164] [SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33082)
*De Jiang,Shuo Zhang,Kehong Yuan,Hongen Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SemReward-VL 利用临床筛查结果作为语义奖励信号，通过 GRPO 训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的 LoRA 适配器，从发育筛查视频中生成条目特定的行为描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发育筛查视频包含儿童的具体行为表现，但临床记录通常只保存"结果"（如通过/未通过），缺少对实际发生行为的描述。这种"结果"与"过程描述"之间的鸿沟，使得从临床数据中学习可解释的行为描述具有挑战。作者希望让模型直接从临床结果中学会描述条目特定的行为，弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出 SemReward-VL 框架：(1) 视觉语言模型生成候选行为描述；(2) 冻结的语言模型作为评判者，对描述与临床结果的一致性、与筛查条目的相关性、在无关"视频—条目"对上的弃答（abstention）能力，以及描述清晰度进行打分，构成语义奖励；(3) 采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）以该语义奖励更新 LoRA 适配器，实现无需人工描述标注的强化学习训练。

Result: 在覆盖 41 个筛查条目、共 13,379 段视频的数据集上，该方法提升了总体准确率，并增加了召回率高于 0.5 的条目数量。但错误仍集中在时间方向、行为持续时长以及年龄特异性行为解读三个方面。

Conclusion: SemReward-VL 验证了以临床结果为语义奖励、通过 GRPO 微调 VLM 来生成条目特定行为描述的可行性，在聚合准确率和条目级召回覆盖上均取得提升；同时揭示了时间方向、时长与年龄特异性解读仍是当前方法的瓶颈，指出未来改进方向。

Abstract: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

</details>


### [165] [dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33083)
*Aditya Bagri,Ashutosh Kumar,Chaitanya Lakhchaura,Avinash Anand,Zhengkui Wang,Rajiv Ratn Shah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究固定帧预算下的事件视频证据分配问题，提出阶段结构化可微选择器 dKFD，在 DoTA 异常识别上大幅提升选择器-事件对齐度，同时保持识别与时序定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视频理解需在固定帧预算下选取少量视觉证据。主流稀疏选择器将预算全局分配，令所有帧相互竞争。对于时间上局部化的事件，这种归纳偏置不佳：有用证据常分布于事件前上下文、事件本身与事件后结果三个阶段。作者据此研究面向局部化事件视频的固定预算证据分配。

Method: 先诊断问题：全局竞争式 Top-K 选择器虽能保持识别与定位，但事件证据不稳定。随后提出 dKFD——一种阶段结构化（phase-structured）的可微选择器，在完成全序列时序编码后，将证据容量分别预留于事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段，并引入阶段监督。

Result: 在 DoTA 视频异常识别上，K=12 时 Global Top-K 识别与时序定位均具竞争力，但选择器-事件对齐度低（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）。匹配预算多随机种子评估下，dKFD 的 Frame AUC 相对匹配的 Global Top-K 提升 +30.97（p<0.01），识别指标有温和但统计显著的增益，时序定位相当。消融显示阶段监督是关键：即使保留阶段划分预算，去除阶段监督后 Frame AUC 降至 41.1±12.0。在 VRU-Accident 上，dKFD 跨多种 VLM 系列均优于学习式 Global Top-K；稠密描述任务中出现边界条件——均匀采样仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 阶段结构化分配是一种面向事件中心稀疏证据选择的可控固定预算方法，而非通用的视频摘要策略；其有效性依赖阶段监督，且存在任务边界条件。

Abstract: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

</details>


### [166] [QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33088)
*Yuan Qian,Jie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP）任务，支持以类别名、同义词和带意图句子作为查询，返回查询特定掩膜及配对的双时相语义图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统变化检测仅识别变化区域，语义变化检测按预定义地类标注，均难以满足用户个性化需求；现有类别提示式指代变化检测（RCD）仅用查询类别指定变化目的地，只返回二值掩膜，缺乏对"由何变为何"的显式源-目标推理与配对语义图。

Method: QSCP 将请求解析为意图与语义槽，构建双向视觉证据，并使用查询条件化解码器预测两个时相的语义状态。

Result: 在 SECOND 数据集上，QSCP 在同义词、句子与转移查询上优于 RCDNet，并相较所评估的语义基线提升了端到端语义预测；WHU-CDC 实验进一步验证了无目标域训练下的跨数据集迁移与等价表达一致性。

Conclusion: QSCP 通过意图解析与查询条件化解码实现选择性、可解释的语义变化解析，兼顾查询灵活性与双时相语义输出。

Abstract: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

</details>


### [167] [Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33097)
*Zhihao Chen,Yiyuan Ge,Ziyang Wang,Pu Cao,Lu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）模型部署成本高的问题，提出了一个两阶段高效VLN框架：先构建显式、可压缩的教师模型，再通过查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口训练紧凑学生模型，在标准基准上学生性能接近教师，参数量减少93.65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模视觉语言导航模型虽精度高，但参数量庞大、计算需求高，导致部署成本高昂。论文旨在实现高效VLN，在保持导航性能的同时大幅压缩模型规模。

Method: 方法分两步。第一步构建高性能教师模型：引入一小组可学习查询槽（query slots），通过Navigable Query Generator从全景观测中提取全局与局部的、动作充分的导航证据；再用Instruction-Query Aligner将这些证据token逐步与指令对齐以进行策略预测，形成显式且可压缩的查询瓶颈。第二步以该显式查询瓶颈为蒸馏接口训练紧凑学生模型，迁移“关注何处”与“执行何种动作”两类知识：用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏教师的全局和局部导航查询，并在微调阶段进一步匹配动作分布。

Result: 在标准VLN基准上的实验表明，学生模型的导航性能几乎与教师模型持平，同时参数量相比教师减少93.65%。

Conclusion: 通过显式查询瓶颈设计教师模型并将其作为蒸馏接口，可有效实现高效VLN，在几乎不损失导航性能的前提下将参数量降低约93.65%，验证了结构化证据选择与查询级蒸馏在压缩VLN模型上的有效性。

Abstract: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

</details>


### [168] [Octree-based Video Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33100)
*Rungui Zhou,Chuanzhi Zhou,Yuk-Kit Hou,Peng-Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OctVideo 用八叉树表示视频：将时空体递归划分为八个子体，平滑区粗、细节区细，叶子存局部RGB与时空梯度并加轻量残差；用Conv1D VAE序列化重建，高效且泛化好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频模型普遍使用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间和时间上差异显著，均匀采样造成冗余与算力浪费，因此需要能自适应分配表示精度的视频表示方法。

Method: OctVideo 以八叉树近似视频片段，递归将时空体划分为八个子体：平滑区域保持粗粒度，细节区域获得更细的单元。每个叶子存储局部RGB值与时空梯度，并由轻量级学习到的残差补充。重建时用Conv1D VAE将序列化的单元映射到规则潜在网格，并在解码中selectively细化细节。

Result: 在Kinetics-400上，VAE达36.12 dB PSNR，38.2M参数，每片段189.4 GFLOPs；零样本泛化到高分辨率DAVIS 2016，重建质量与最佳评测模型相当。两个数据集上其模型FLOPs最少，编解码最快；从零训练时以少量输入token在视频理解任务上取得有竞争力识别性能。

Conclusion: 通过利用视频信号自身冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo为视频提供了一种高效表示，兼顾重建质量、计算效率与理解任务的迁移能力。

Abstract: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

</details>


### [169] [Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33109)
*Tuo Liang,Disheng Liu,Nengbo Wang,Vipin Chaudhary,Yu Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"朝向定位(orientation grounding)"这一指代性定位新任务,要求模型根据语言或框查询预测物体的6D朝向与轴向对称性;为此构建了ReferOri数据集(多视图331K、单视图387K查询),并提出OG-VLM模型,在多视图与单视图基准上显著优于面向朝向的VLM基线,并在场景级指代基准上超越物体级朝向基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间视觉语言模型大多只关注指代物体"在哪里"(位置),而许多3D任务还需知道物体"如何朝向"。尽管现有3D VLM可预测有向框,但框的姿态无法显式刻画以物体为中心的朝向,也无法处理对称性带来的朝向歧义。

Method: 1) 定义朝向定位任务:从语言或框查询出发,在单视图或多视图场景中预测物体的6D朝向及轴向对称性。2) 构建ReferOri数据集:通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证,获得多视图331K、单视图387K的朝向定位查询。3) 提出OG-VLM:对3D VLM进行适配,输出结构化的框/朝向、引入符号与对称性token,并采用几何感知的辅助损失。

Result: 在单视图与多视图基准上,OG-VLM大幅超越面向朝向的VLM基线;在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型;下游任务结果验证其对朝向相关空间推理的益处。

Conclusion: 显式朝向定位是一种有别于定位的、可学习的新能力,能够为朝向相关的空间推理带来实际收益。

Abstract: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

</details>


### [170] [Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33125)
*Zhizhen Zhang,Yuxia Fu,Zijian Wang,Helen Huang,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PolicyWeave：通过保持共享动作接口的兼容性后训练与上下文引导的稀疏合并，将独立训练的VLA专家有效整合为多任务策略，在RoboCasa365上显著优于静态合并与联合强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务VLA策略常采用协同训练，但其性能往往不及各任务独立训练。目标是在不进行联合后训练的前提下，保留单任务专家的性能增益。直接合并独立训练的专家是自然思路，但强专家未必组成强策略。作者识别出该不兼容的一个来源：任务特定的动作接口改动，包括动作归一化以及动作编码器与解码器。

Method: 提出PolicyWeave，包含两部分：（1）合并兼容的后训练——所有专家保留公共基础策略的动作接口，任务适配仅限定在动作模型隐藏层的LoRA更新，从而提高与现有模型合并方法的兼容性；（2）上下文引导的稀疏合并——用初始视觉-语言上下文对每个专家的LoRA更新打分，通过留一层排序稳定性确定专家集合，对所选更新形成稀疏加权合并，并在当前任务中保持固定，以避免部署时无关任务的干扰。

Result: 在GR00T N1.5上于18个RoboCasa365任务评估，仅使用10%目标任务示范做SFT。保持共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从17.0%提升至52.8%。PolicyWeave在SFT专家上达到64.7%，任务特定RL后达74.1%，而联合RL为60.7%。在LIBERO-10与AgileX Piper机械臂上的进一步评估支持独立学习技能在长时程与真实世界操作中的部署。

Conclusion: 任务特定动作接口差异是专家合并不兼容的关键来源；保持共享动作接口并采用上下文引导的稀疏合并，能在不联合后训练的情况下有效保留单任务增益，优于静态合并与联合强化学习，并可推广到长时程与真实机器人操作场景。

Abstract: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

</details>


### [171] [DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33148)
*Liang Yao,Fan Liu,Hongbo Lu,Wei Xu,Jianyu Jiang,Yijun Shen,Chuanyi Zhang,Pai Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DroneWAM，一种基于JEPA架构的高效世界-动作模型，用于无人机视觉导航，通过表示空间建模与自适应rollout在保证精度同时降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视觉导航中，世界-动作模型需在严格的精度与效率约束下预测候选动作对观测的影响。显式生成未来图像代价高，且每个想象步重复计算开销大，需在场景间更有效地分配预测计算。

Method: 采用JEPA架构在表示空间直接建模未来状态，避免显式图像生成；用预训练Resampler将稠密编码器特征压缩为少量潜在token以减少每步重复计算；引入自适应rollout，由偏好训练的Gate根据当前场景动态分配预测深度；并构建含RGB观测、6-DoF轨迹、控制指令及随机风扰的模拟数据集DroneNav-6D。

Result: 在DroneNav-6D上，DroneWAM在对比方法中取得最佳轨迹精度；自适应rollout将平均预测深度从8降至4.58，同时提升轨迹精度。

Conclusion: 在表示空间建模结合自适应计算分配可有效提升无人机视觉导航的预测效率与精度，表明预测计算能跨场景更合理地分配。

Abstract: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

</details>


### [172] [FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33158)
*David Restrepo,Chenwei Wu,Luis Filipe Nakayama,Miguel L. Martins,Stergios Christodoulidis,Maria Vakalopoulou,Enzo Ferrante*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FOCUS，一个跨数据集视网膜眼底模型基准，统一十套公开数据集上的三类任务，从排序、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性等维度大规模评估视觉编码器、视觉-语言双编码器和多模态大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于基础模型的视网膜图像分析进展迅速，但可靠性评估仍具挑战：单数据集上的性能无法反映数据集偏移、临床定义差异和不同患者亚组下的表现。而在医学影像中，鲁棒性、校准与公平性对安全部署至关重要，因此需要一个多维度的跨数据集评估框架。

Method: 提出FOCUS基准，覆盖视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）三类模型族。基准统一了糖尿病视网膜病变、需转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变三项二分类任务，涵盖十套地理、采集条件和标注协议各异的公开数据集。通过统一分析层评估排序性能、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性，并对532个基础配置和228个经LoRA监督微调的MLLM配置进行了大规模评测。

Result: 结果显示，没有任何模型族能在所有任务和数据集上持续占优：通用VM编码器平均排序性能最强；医学MLLM具有竞争力但波动较大；双编码器VLM从轻量适配中获益显著。微调能提升域内性能，但向外部数据集的迁移表现异质，尤其在校准方面差异明显。

Conclusion: 视网膜模型评估本质上是多维的。FOCUS提供了实用框架与公开基准，可在单数据集排行榜之外评估模型的泛化性、可靠性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

</details>


### [173] [FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33167)
*Yiyi Cai,Yuhan Wu,Kunhang Li,Tu Fangyuan,Xiangyue Zhang,Qiaoge Li,Zhixiang Wang,Kaipeng Zhang,Haiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FD2流式动作生成框架，通过Partial Attention实现KV缓存推理，用Bregman准则指导FK二次损失，并加入精确路径控制，训练计算降4.6倍、去噪加速11.29倍，同时刷新流式方法FID记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前作FD1虽能生成合理动作，但效率低、可控性差：注意力设计需对整个历史反复计算，且缺乏对真实应用至关重要的精确轨迹控制。论文旨在同时解决效率、可训练性与路径可控性问题，并提升生成质量。

Method: 三项改进：(1) Partial Attention使已确定的历史表示与当前活动窗口解耦，从而支持KV缓存推理与共享历史打包训练；(2) 建立回归损失的Bregman充要判据，以保持扩散模型的条件均值速度场，据此设计FK诱导的二次损失，在无需在线FK评估的情况下引入运动几何；(3) 精确路径条件控制角色根轨迹，同时保持自然的身体动作。

Result: 训练计算量减少4.6倍，去噪加速11.29倍，长序列上每次更新达2.303 ms；在效率提升的同时动作质量优于FD1，并在流式方法中取得最优FID：SEED上0.048、HumanML3D上0.053。

Conclusion: FD2在效率与可控性上显著超越FD1，验证了Partial Attention的缓存可行性、Bregman准则对速度场保持的理论价值以及路径条件控制的有效性，成为流式动作生成的新SOTA。

Abstract: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

</details>


### [174] [ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33176)
*Ruoxuan Shi,Sheng Yang,Zhengxing Su,Xiaoyang Hou,Yating Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ABO-Med——将一阶双层优化范式引入 MAML 框架用于医学图像小样本分类，并提出模态感知的数据增强策略 MedRAug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统双层优化算法通常依赖二阶信息计算，限制了实际可扩展性；近期虽已建立一阶双层优化范式并取得近最优理论保证，但尚缺乏在小样本医学图像分类中的高效实例化方案。

Method: 将一阶双层优化范式嵌入 MAML 框架，构建可扩展的实例化方法 ABO-Med，并针对医学图像设计模态感知增强策略 MedRAug（Medical Adaptive RandomAugment）。

Result: 在多个公开医学数据集上优于已有基线，提升幅度为 1.99%–18.76%；MedRAug 进一步提升平均准确率 2.20%–6.34%。跨域实验、增强消融、骨干网络消融及训练效率分析均验证了方法的有效性与高效性。

Conclusion: ABO-Med 在理论上确立了 MAML 类元学习方法的（近）最优性，并在实证上验证了其在医学图像小样本分类中的有效性与效率。

Abstract: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

</details>


### [175] [Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33178)
*Di Zhang,Zhangpeng Gong,Jiashuai Liu,Zhi Zeng,Jiusong Ge,Chunze Yang,Xitong Ling,Kai Yi,Kai He,Weimiao Yu,Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar,Chen Li,Zeyu Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出三阶段框架ProSlide，将蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移解耦：先预训练蛋白质组基础编码器（PFE），再预训练补丁-区域-切片层次病理编码器，最后用Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏缓解配对支撑瓶颈，在乳腺、肺、肾癌12项下游任务上取得各组最高平均准确率与AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子引导的病理基础模型（PFM）利用转录组或蛋白质组信息增强全切片图像（WSI）表征，但难以有效利用大规模独立分子语料：一是现有分子基础模型编码蛋白质序列或单细胞状态，而非与WSI配对的病人级bulk表达谱；二是跨模态监督仅限配对WSI-组学样本，导致独立分子语料的知识只能间接到达病理编码器，形成"配对支撑瓶颈"。

Method: 三阶段框架。第一阶段：为弥合模态鸿沟，在12,695个样本级bulk蛋白质谱上通过虚拟谱生成与表达空间多视图预训练，构建蛋白质组基础编码器（PFE）。第二阶段：预训练ProSlide——补丁-区域-切片层次编码器，从配对的WSI-蛋白质样本中预测蛋白质表达。第三阶段：提出Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏目标，对每个配对样本，将其WSI与蛋白质谱在共享的、冻结的PFE编码配对及独立谱库上的相似度分布进行对齐，以缓解配对支撑瓶颈。

Result: 在乳腺、肺、肾癌共12项下游任务上评估ProSlide。尽管仅用2,229张WSI和12,695个样本级蛋白质谱预训练，ProSlide在每个癌种组内的平均准确率与AUC均为最高。

Conclusion: 通过解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，并引入关系蒸馏放松配对支撑瓶颈，ProSlide能以有限配对数据高效融合独立分子语料，实现多癌种下游任务的最优性能。

Abstract: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

</details>


### [176] [FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33190)
*Zhiyuan Liu,Zehong Ke,Yuanxin Tian,Hao Cheng,Jinhao Li,Yining Xing,Yanbo Jiang,Zhenhua Xu,Wenhao Yu,Jianqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FocusDrive，一个以显式视觉焦点为核心的结构化多模态推理框架，将决策相关物体描述与图像patch引用配对，用于端到端驾驶规划的推理与轨迹生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶决策既取决于"关注何处"也取决于"如何根据所见行动"。基于文本的推理链虽能描述驾驶响应，却难以显式建立与具体视觉证据的对应关系；视觉焦点则通过指明"什么重要、在哪里"为场景理解与驾驶动作之间提供具体联系。

Method: 将决策相关物体描述与图像patch引用配对，把显式视觉焦点纳入生成驾驶规划与轨迹的推理过程。先通过驾驶员注视点预测评估该焦点表示，再利用NAVSIM训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注研究其在规划推理中的作用。

Result: 在W3DA和NAVSIM上的实验表明，该框架在注视点预测和端到端规划上均具竞争力，且FocusDrive优于基于文本的思维链方法。

Conclusion: 视觉焦点可作为连接场景理解与驾驶动作的有效桥梁。

Abstract: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

</details>


### [177] [ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33202)
*Xuanhua Yin,Chuanzhi Xu,Haoxian Zhou,Shunqi Mao,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReAL：一种免训练的流匹配采样器，仅用一次共享前瞻即可自适应选择推进步长，实现图像/视频生成加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配模型生成质量高，但反复的神经网络评估使采样代价高昂。通过将已有速度估计外推到更长区间可跳过部分评估，但仅凭局部速度一致性无法确定合适的跨度，而逐个检查候选端点又会增加昂贵的模型调用。

Method: 提出 ReAL（training-free sampler）：核心洞察是"未校正端点提议"与"前瞻校正后端点提议"之间的差异，可由观测到的速度失配与前瞻之外的候选跨度直接计算得出，因此无需额外端点评估即可获得随跨度变化的选择准则。同一前瞻用于三类操作：选取最长可通过的候选跨度、校正被接受的更新、并将其速度作为下一轮的起始估计。初始化后，每个常规迭代仅需一次新的模型评估；仅使用预训练速度输出与原始噪声调度，无需额外训练或访问内部特征。

Result: 实验覆盖四个图像生成骨干、视频生成与图像编辑。在 FLUX.1-dev 上实测加速 4.91 倍，同时保留 97.0% 的稠密采样平均 ImageReward；在 HunyuanVideo 上实现 5.49 倍加速，VBench 分数接近稠密采样。

Conclusion: ReAL 通过一次共享前瞻给出跨度相关的选择准则，在不引入额外端点评估的前提下实现自适应大步长更新，作为免训练采样器在图像与视频生成任务上取得显著加速并保持高质量。

Abstract: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

</details>


### [178] [Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33203)
*Yuhe Liu,Xinyin Ma,Gongfan Fang,Songhua Liu,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将DiT中被动求和的残差连接改造为主动检索机制，通过结构化跨层连接显著提升图像生成性能，且额外参数不足0.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT采用统一残差流整合所有前层信息，不同于U-Net依赖手工跳跃连接，缺乏对关键早期特征的选择性利用，跨层信息通路设计尚属未被充分探索的因素。

Method: 先系统分析DiT内部表示，发现其对早期层特征复用和对称层引导的潜在偏好；据此提出结构化连接设计，将局部残差连接与长程通路结合，使每个Transformer块可通过可微的跨深度路径选择性"关注"关键早期表示，动态检索空间与语义线索。

Result: 收敛更快，训练迭代减少至多1.73倍；FID与视觉质量显著提升，额外参数不足0.1%；将强REPA-XL/2模型无引导FID从5.9改进至4.34，使用classifier-free guidance达到1.39。

Conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散Transformer中关键但尚未充分探索的因素，引入结构化信息通路为改进可扩展生成模型提供了简单有效的方向。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

</details>


### [179] [Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33210)
*Xuanhua Yin,Boyu Wei,Shuyi Zhang,Shunqi Mao,Chuanzhi Xu,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在类条件流匹配中研究背景图像如何影响目标图像的记忆与复制，提出成对轨迹框架，识别出背景梯度响应是调控目标学习保持与复制的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复与生成模型中的记忆密切相关，但除重复次数外，其他训练图像如何影响目标的保持与复制尚不清楚。

Method: 在类条件流匹配中，将目标集之外的图像设为背景；构建成对轨迹框架，分离目标诱导的参数位移及背景对其的梯度响应，并给出精确的路径积分曲率表示；通过重复背景与不同背景之间的响应迁移进行因果验证。

Result: 在目标重复次数与同类背景行数固定时，将重复同类图像替换为不同图像，目标提取率从80.7%降至18.0%；响应迁移双向改变目标保持与复制；去除目标后，响应沿目标诱导位移方向的校正保留了约90%的复制效应；直接缩放位移无需再训练即可改变复制；去除目标后的复制效应跨数据集与架构可复现。

Conclusion: 背景梯度响应是同类训练数据塑造目标学习保持与目标图像复制的机制。

Abstract: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer. Directly scaling the displacement also changes copying without further training. The post-removal copying effects of reciprocal transfer are reproduced across datasets and architectures. Together, these results identify the background gradient response as a mechanism through which same-class training data shape the retention of target learning and the reproduction of target images.

</details>


### [180] [RepFlow: Reciprocal Supervision Improves Generation and Representation in Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33217)
*Weili Zeng,Feng Tian,Shengqi Liu,Yichao Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RepFlow 从生成器演化计算中学习稳定视觉表示，并以互惠过程同时提升生成质量与表示质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型通过去噪学习视觉结构，但其内部状态同时纠缠于噪声水平和网络深度，难以从生成器本身获得稳定的视觉表示。

Method: 训练一个无时间步编码器，通过时间步条件预测器，从掩码干净图像中恢复不同深度与噪声水平下的生成器状态；编码器输入排除参考噪声与被掩码内容，以蒸馏可从可见图像上下文恢复、并能预测生成器状态的视觉信息。所得表示反馈用于引导并改进生成器，更新后的生成器状态又为表示学习提供监督，形成互惠学习过程。

Result: 在 ImageNet 上对隐空间 SiT 与像素空间 JiT 进行冻结线性探测，无需外部预训练表示教师；两种无条件设定下 FID 相对原生训练下降 19.2%–40.8%，线性探测精度较最佳搜索的原始生成器特征提升 6.80–10.04 个百分点。该表示还可作为一步 JiT 后训练中的分布度量，将作用从实例级对齐扩展到分布级监督。

Conclusion: RepFlow 通过从生成器演化状态中学习表示并形成互惠学习，同时提升多步生成与表示质量，并拓展了所学表示在后训练分布级监督中的应用。

Abstract: Generative models learn visual structure through denoising, yet their internal states are entangled with both noise level and network depth, making it difficult to obtain a stable visual representation from the generator itself. We introduce RepFlow, which learns such a representation from the generator's evolving computation and uses it to guide generation. Specifically, a separate timestep-free encoder is trained, through a timestep-conditioned predictor, to recover generator states across depths and noise levels from masked clean images. By excluding the reference noise and masked-out content from the encoder's input, we encourage the encoder to distill visual information that is recoverable from the visible image context and predictive of generator states. The representation learned from the generator's evolving states is then fed back to guide and improve the generator, whose updated states provide supervision for further representation learning, forming a reciprocal learning process. This reciprocal process improves multi-step generation and representation quality, as measured by frozen linear probing on ImageNet with latent-space SiT and pixel-space JiT, without an externally pretrained representation teacher. Across the two unconditional settings, FID decreases by $19.2$--$40.8\%$ relative to native training, while linear-probe accuracy improves by 6.80--10.04 percentage points over the best searched raw generator features. The learned representation also serves as a distributional metric for one-step JiT post-training, extending its role from instance-level alignment to distribution-level supervision.

</details>


### [181] [Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33218)
*Chunzheng Li,Zesheng Jia,Hongda Zhang,Jiaying Tang,Yuntian Wang,Siao Liu,Jin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Scope-WM是一种高效视觉世界模型，通过将计算集中在预测相关的潜在区域和有前景的动作序列上，在保持任务性能的同时大幅降低规划延迟与显存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉世界模型虽可用于机器人规划，但密集潜在状态传播与样本密集型轨迹优化带来高推理延迟和峰值显存，难以在资源受限平台实时部署。现有稀疏加速方法或采用无引导的token稀疏化（可能丢弃规划相关信息、稀疏度受限），或引入沉重辅助模块与繁琐多阶段训练流程。

Method: Scope-WM将预测相关性蒸馏进轻量级动作条件选择器，仅对选中的紧凑token子集执行完整动力学预测；其余token通过前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要进行更新，使背景无需昂贵的token间交互即可感知前景动态。规划阶段保留并复用初始MPC搜索中发现的高质量动作序列，在缩减的rollout预算下聚焦后续搜索。训练仅需一次性选择器蒸馏加单阶段稀疏世界模型联合训练。

Result: 在Push-T任务上，Scope-WM将峰值GPU显存和规划时间分别降至稠密DINO-WM的18.1%和14.3%，对应6.97倍规划加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务性能；在五个多样化视觉规划任务上的进一步评估验证了其通用性。

Conclusion: Scope-WM通过相关性引导的稀疏计算与动作序列复用，实现了高效且通用的视觉世界模型规划，显著缓解了推理延迟与显存瓶颈，适用于资源受限平台的实时部署。

Abstract: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.

</details>


### [182] [AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33230)
*Gautham Narayan Narasimhan,Heethesh Vhavle,Kumar Bhargav Viswanatha,James Reuther,Deva Ramanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个远距离FMCW LiDAR数据集与基准，包含575个序列（57.5K帧）、超800万个3D框注释，覆盖16个检测类别与24个语义类别，并验证了多普勒速度对远距离检测与场景流的显著提升作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FMCW LiDAR可同时测量每个点的径向多普勒速度与距离，提供传统ToF传感器不具备的运动线索。然而，如何在远距离场景中利用该信号仍缺乏系统研究，且缺少相应的大规模数据集与基准。

Method: 构建FMCW LiDAR数据集：575个序列、57.5K帧，8M+标注3D框、16个检测类别、24个语义类别，由6个商用FMCW LiDAR与6个配对的4K相机采集，覆盖8个城市，含237个夜间序列，标注距离达400m。设立包含3D目标检测、场景流估计和语义分割三项任务的基准，检测与场景流按三个距离区间评估至400m，并提供公开评测服务器。

Result: 多普勒测量显著提升了主流识别任务性能：远距离车辆与行人的检测AP最高提升2倍，在低延迟单帧设置中尤为明显；场景流精度在所有距离区间均显著提升。

Conclusion: 该工作公开了数据集与基准（https://scenes.aeva.com），证明多普勒速度是提升远距离3D感知的关键线索，为FMCW LiDAR感知研究提供了大规模评测平台。

Abstract: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.

</details>


### [183] [PARSEE-VAD: Efficient Training-Free Online Video Anomaly Detection via Proposition-Aware Reasoning and Streaming Evidence Escalation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33236)
*Ji Wang,Shuangqing Zhang,Guo-Sen Xie,Fang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PARSEE-VAD是一个免训练在线视频异常检测框架，通过分离语义证据获取与分数状态演化，在当前因果窗口内提取结构化命题证据，仅传播有界分数状态以维持时序连续性，在四个基准上实现强免训练在线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 免训练在线视频异常检测（VAD）结合冻结多模态语言模型面临两个耦合挑战：一是在因果与计算约束下提取可靠的当前窗口语义；二是在不反复传输高维历史的前提下维持时序连续性。用文本编码历史虽可压缩视觉证据却引入语义偏差，而保留视觉历史则会扩大多模态上下文。

Method: 提出PARSEE-VAD，含两个模块：Proposition-Aware Reasoning（PAR）从当前因果窗口提取结构化命题证据，当粗粒度证据需要时条件式激活更具体的查询，并通过跨查询共享可复用的因果视觉前缀、以选择性执行减少冗余计算；Streaming Evidence Escalation（SEE）将命题证据经当前证据升级映射为紧凑的分数域事件状态，仅传播有界状态以支撑时序连续性。

Result: 在四个基准上实验显示，方法在免训练条件下取得较强的在线性能；选择性路由降低了专家计算量，分数状态传播保持稀疏。

Conclusion: 结果支持流式多模态推理的"当前优先"原则：先解析当前语义，再仅用紧凑历史状态修补残余的连续性缺口。

Abstract: Training-free online video anomaly detection (VAD) with frozen multimodal language models faces two coupled challenges: extracting reliable current-window semantics under causal and computational constraints, and maintaining temporal continuity without repeatedly transmitting high-dimensional history. Encoding history through text can compress visual evidence and introduce semantic bias, whereas retaining visual history expands multimodal context. We introduce PARSEE-VAD, a two-module framework that separates semantic evidence acquisition from score-state evolution. Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) extracts structured propositional evidence from the current causal window and conditionally activates more specific queries when coarse evidence warrants further refinement. By sharing a reusable causal visual prefix across queries, PAR reduces redundant computation through selective execution. Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) maps the acquired proposition evidence into a compact score-domain event state through current evidence escalation, then propagates only the resulting bounded state across decisions to support temporal continuity. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong training-free online performance while selective routing reduces specialist computation and score-state propagation remains sparse. These results support a current-first principle for streaming multimodal inference: resolve present semantics first, then use compact historical state only to repair residual continuity gaps.

</details>


### [184] [VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33253)
*Kangjie Chen,Xiangyu Li,Dongbin Zhang,Chaoda Zheng,Shijia Chen,Jinhao Deng,Hongbin Lin,Choo Sin Wai,Minqi Wang,Minghao Yang,Dake Zhong,Guorui Song,Yu Zhang,Xianming Liu,Boyang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VGGT-Diff 是一种几何路由的多视图扩散模型，将 VGGT-Ω 的视觉几何潜变量接入预训练视频扩散模型，用于稀疏视图新视角合成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 NVS 方法存在根本性权衡：重建类方法能保留已观测几何但难以合成未见区域；扩散类方法具备强生成先验，却依赖隐式的源到查询对应关系。论文旨在弥合这两类范式的鸿沟。

Method: 将 VGGT-Ω 的视觉几何潜变量路由至预训练视频扩散模型。每个视觉 token 关联一个 3D 点及其置信度，通过置信度感知的 Visual Geometry Router (VGR) 转换为与查询对齐的潜条件，并保留前/后表面证据。这些条件引导联合目标视角去噪；Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) 沿可靠 3D 轨迹对预测的干净残差进行正则化，提升多视图稳定性。此外引入鲁棒几何条件化，结合训练时正则化与推理时引导。

Result: 实验显示，在不同视角难度下的插值与外推任务中均取得有竞争力或最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 几何路由与扩散先验的结合以及 PTRC 正则化和鲁棒条件化，可有效提升稀疏视图 NVS 的合成质量与多视图稳定性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.

</details>


### [185] [EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33261)
*Jinchang Zhang,Yingda Tao,Jiakai Lin,Guoyu Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出EngIntervene基准，评估多模态模型在工程感知与设计生成之间的"缺失中间环节"——基于已理解系统状态进行关系、约束与干预后果推理的能力，包含7个工程领域、3229道题、四个层级（T1状态定位、T2关系机理推理、T3约束诊断、T4干预推理）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态工程基准多评估静态理解（识别部件、解读图纸、回答技术问题），缺失了工程感知与完整设计生成之间的能力评估空白，即模型能否利用已理解的系统状态来推理关系、约束及设计变更的后果。

Method: 构建EngIntervene基准：涵盖7个工程领域、3229道题；将评估分为四级——T1状态定位、T2关系与机理推理、T3约束感知诊断、T4干预推理（判断所提修改是否达成目标并保持约束）。任务采用统一工程状态表示（对象、关系、约束、设计目标），T2–T4用结构化参考答案与原子化评分标准打分。并设置消融：移除或打乱视觉证据、领域特定监督微调。

Result: 在开源与闭源多模态模型上，更强的状态定位并不能稳定转化为更好的诊断或干预能力；最佳开源模型在T2–T4平均分上落后最佳闭源模型14.7个百分点。移除或打乱视觉证据会持续降低性能；基准特定监督微调提升了T1但未提升T2–T4。T4还暴露出满足单个修改标准与产出完全有效干预之间的巨大差距。

Conclusion: 工程推理不仅要求恢复当前系统状态，还要求可靠地利用该状态推理约束与干预后后果；当前模型在这一"缺失中间"能力上存在明显短板。代码与基准工件已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

</details>


### [186] [VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33264)
*Tianyi Wang,Wangsheng Du,Jiazhou Chen,Tianyi Zeng,Xiangyu Li,Jiseop Byeon,Yujin Wang,Yiming Xu,Yangyang Wang,Bingzhao Gao,Sikai Chen,Zhaomiao Guo,Junfeng Jiao,Christian Claudel,Alexandre Bayen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VehDyn：面向驾驶世界模型的车辆动力学基准，基于CARLA-CarSim联合仿真构建，含10,080组受控配置与同步车辆状态，提出层次化评估框架并评测12个SOTA视频世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基准主要评估视觉保真度与粗粒度物理合理性，无法验证生成未来是否遵循真实车辆运动学与动力学；同时缺乏车辆、道路、机动、速度条件可独立控制且视频与真值车辆状态同步记录的数据集。

Method: 构建CARLA-CarSim联合仿真平台，将照片级渲染与经过验证的多体动力学模型耦合；通过全因子设计生成10,080组配置，覆盖5种车型、4种轮胎-路面摩擦系数、3种机动、4种目标速度、14个场景、3种光照，每组配同步的位置、速度与姿态序列；在此基础上提出层次化评估框架，度量轨迹对齐、运动学一致性与动力学一致性，并对12个SOTA视频世界模型进行基准测试；另用两种既有协议评估视频质量并与VehDyn得分做相关性分析。

Result: 轨迹级指标近乎饱和，12个模型中有10个在真值20%误差范围内；无模型在动力学一致性上达到真值的92%；视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。DrivingWorld取得最高VehDyn得分，其后为Cosmos 3 Nano与LTX-Video 2.5；VehDyn得分与人类判断高度一致。

Conclusion: VehDyn为开发兼具物理一致性与视觉真实性的驾驶世界模型提供了系统化基础，揭示了当前模型在动力学一致性上的显著缺口。

Abstract: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.

</details>


### [187] [InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33286)
*Cheng Yang,Chufan Shi,Huijuan Wang,Bo Shui,Yaokang Wu,Muzi Tao,Yibo Yan,Xuezhe Ma,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 InfoEdit 基准，首次针对信息图（infographics）等结构化视觉内容编辑设置专门评测，并提出"reflow"（全局布局推理）概念与相应评测协议；实验显示现有多模态编辑器在该任务上表现极差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态基础模型可对自然照片实现生产级编辑，但在信息图等结构化视觉内容上表现不佳。与照片不同，信息图通过逻辑关系编码信息，编辑某一元素往往需联动调整周边元素（即"reflow"全局布局推理能力）。然而现有图像编辑基准既缺乏面向结构化视觉内容的专用设置，也无法评测 reflow 能力，因此需要新基准加以诊断。

Method: 构建 InfoEdit 基准：包含 1,000 张信息图，覆盖 8 类逻辑关系族；配套 4,000 条编辑指令，涵盖 4 类编辑任务；并设计 reflow-aware（感知重排）的评测协议。在 8 个前沿编辑器上进行评测，并对比代码级编辑与像素级编辑的表现。

Result: 仅有 GPT-Image-2 平均成功率超过 60%，多数模型低于 7%；在 Swap-Block 任务上，即使目标定位完全正确，也没有任何编辑器超过 36% 的成功率。此外，代码级编辑在部分任务上可媲美最强的像素级编辑器，显示出任务间的互补优势。

Conclusion: InfoEdit 确立了 reflow 是结构化视觉内容编辑的核心挑战，并提供了可用于诊断与推动未来进展的基准。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

</details>


### [188] [Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33288)
*Kaname Kitamura,Asako Kanezaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对开放词汇情景记忆EQA（EM-EQA），提出一种基于全向图像的视角选择方法：用立方体贴图投影把等距柱面图像转为透视视角，用微调BLIP-2估计问题相关度，再经多样性感知贪心选择挑选信息量大的视角。在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上达到已报道模型中的SOTA，且去掉旋转视角（减少65.5%帧）后准确率基本保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全向图像视野广、无需显式旋转相机即可捕捉周围上下文，适合EM-EQA，但存在两个问题：(i) 等距柱面投影造成严重几何畸变，降低VLM识别精度；(ii) 直接输入等距柱面图像会引入大量无关背景，降低答案准确率并增加视觉token负担。

Method: 1) 将等距柱面观测经立方体贴图投影转换为透视视角；2) 用微调后的BLIP-2估计以问题为条件的相关度；3) 通过多样性感知的贪心选择，选出信息丰富且多样的视角。

Result: 在OpenEQA的Habitat-Matterport 3D（HM3D）子集上，方法在已报道的等距柱面观测模型结果中取得SOTA性能；去除旋转视角后观测帧减少65.5%，答案准确率仍大体保持。

Conclusion: 通过立方体贴图投影+问题条件相关度估计+多样性感知贪心选择，可有效缓解全向图像畸变与冗余背景问题，在显著减少观测帧的情况下维持EM-EQA的答案准确率。

Abstract: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.

</details>


### [189] [Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33304)
*Fuyao Zhang,Xuan Wang,Zherui Li,Jiaming Zhang,Longtao Huang,Wei Yang Bryan Lim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出任务级检索到的历史经验主要作用在回合首步，对后续90%步骤帮助甚微，根源是"相关性不等于适用性"；提出免训练的 ExpActivator，将个性化重构为经验激活，按当前屏幕在冻结GUI骨干的隐空间中匹配历史状态并提供对应动作参考，从而在四个骨干上平均提升步级成功率28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人化GUI智能体依赖交互历史来推断模糊指令意图并预判重复性例程。现有方法检索任务相关历史并拼接到策略上下文中，隐含假设"与任务相关的经验对该任务内每一步决策都有用"。但实验发现这种帮助几乎都消耗在第一个决策上：检索到的历史显著改善回合开头，在其余90%的步骤中几乎没有持续收益，且对"是否应当主动建议"的指导很弱。一条相关记录能告诉智能体从哪开始，却不能告诉它哪一历史动作适用于当前屏幕、或某个例程现在是否到期。根本问题在于相关性并不蕴含适用性：相关性在任务层面确定，而适用性取决于决策时刻的具体情境。

Method: 将个性化重新表述为"经验激活"（experience activation），提出免训练框架 ExpActivator，只激活适用于当前情境的经验。执行中，它在冻结的GUI骨干的隐空间中将每个新屏幕与历史状态进行匹配，并给出对应动作作为参考；在执行前，仅当当前时间与场景提供足够支持时才激活重复性意图，否则选择弃答（abstain）。

Result: 在四个GUI骨干上，ExpActivator 使轨迹内步级成功率平均提升28%，在每个骨干上均取得最佳个性化执行效果，同时使用的历史token数约为原来的五分之一；在主动建议任务上，其马修斯相关系数（MCC）达到最强主动基线的约2.3倍。

Conclusion: 经验的价值在于被激活之处，而非被拼接之处（Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended）。个性化应从任务级检索转向决策时刻的适用性匹配。

Abstract: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.

</details>


### [190] [LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33306)
*Liang Peng,Chenxiao Li,Libo Zhang,Xingping Dong,Heng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopTrack：一种参数高效的Transformer跟踪框架，通过循环复用共享参数的Transformer块进行特征交互，并引入目标感知循环与门控目标记忆，显著降低参数量同时保持高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的跟踪方法通常堆叠多个参数独立的Transformer块来建模模板与搜索区域交互，导致参数量庞大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。因此需要一种参数高效、部署友好的Transformer跟踪方案。

Method: 提出LoopTrack框架，循环反复应用一组共享参数的Transformer块进行特征交互，显著减少参数量。并设计两个轻量模块：目标感知循环（TAL），利用前一轮循环产生的中间目标信息指导下一轮特征交互，实现渐进式特征细化；门控目标记忆（GTM），跨帧维护紧凑记忆并融入循环过程，为跟踪器提供长期信息以缓解时序漂移。相比现有Transformer跟踪器，可在更少参数下实现多轮特征交互。

Result: 在多个数据集上取得良好的精度-参数权衡。LoopTrack_One仅用单个共享Transformer块、3.4M参数，在LaSOT上达到66.2% SUC；LoopTrack_Three使用三个共享块、6.4M参数，达到69.3% SUC，超越参数量相当或更大的现有参数高效跟踪方法。

Conclusion: LoopTrack为参数高效Transformer跟踪建立了一个简单而强力的基线，代码与模型将开源。

Abstract: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.

</details>


### [191] [PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33318)
*Cunhao Zhu,Dongliang Xu,Xiangtao Kong,Xiaoyan Lu,Tianyu Wang,Yue Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PIC-UIE，一个轻量级的"预测器—执行器"框架：在固定256×256的RGB缩略图上预测图像自适应校正参数，再在原生分辨率的YCbCr色彩空间中对输入图像施加校正。该框架仅9,486个参数、0.094 GFLOPs，在UIEB-90上达到24.137 dB PSNR与0.9216 SSIM，零样本LSUI上21.320 dB PSNR，并在原生4K图像上达到55.0 FPS，表明结构化校正预测是替代稠密RGB重建的实用方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下图像增强（UIE）方法多依赖大骨干网络和稠密的图像到图像预测，难以部署于边缘设备；同时，完全在单一色彩空间中操作会将退化估计与亮度、色度校正耦合在一起，不利于解耦处理。因此需要一种轻量、解耦的增强方案。

Method: 提出PIC-UIE，采用预测器—执行器（predictor–executor）架构。预测器从固定的256×256 RGB缩略图生成七个输出，分为：空间校正、非线性亮度映射、耦合色度映射、图像级色彩标定；执行器在YCbCr色彩空间中将上述校正应用于原生分辨率输入。训练时使用深度图对透射代理（transmission proxy）进行正则化，推理阶段仅需RGB输入。

Result: 模型仅9,486个参数，256×256下为0.094 GFLOPs。在UIEB-90上取得24.137 dB PSNR、0.9216 SSIM；在零样本LSUI上取得21.320 dB PSNR；在对比协议下可对原生4K图像以55.0 FPS处理。

Conclusion: 结果表明，结构化校正预测为水下图像增强提供了一种有效且实用的替代方案，可取代稠密RGB重建，兼顾性能与边缘部署效率。

Abstract: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.

</details>


### [192] [VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33325)
*Siran Peng,Tianshuo Zhang,Tianyu Fu,Weisong Zhao,Haoyuan Zhang,Jiankuo Zhao,Minghui Wu,Ping Jiang,Xiangyu Zhu,Chenxu Zhao,Zhen Lei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VisionHOPE，首个将通用视觉骨干建模为自修改学习系统的框架，使"记忆内容"与"学习规则"在图像内协同演化，并在 ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉骨干从 CNN 的局部聚合、ViT 的全局交互、SSM 的输入依赖状态转移，演进到 TTT 层的内部学习器自适应，计算逐步自适应于输入，但"如何自适应"的规则仍由训练好的骨干预先规定，缺乏自修改能力。作者希望让模型在单张图像内同时共演化"记什么"与"怎么学"。

Method: 基于 Nested Learning 的自指构造，用五个耦合记忆分别存储内容、生成 key/value 表示、以及控制学习率与保留率，并沿扫描过程随视觉上下文累积联合演化。直接施加无约束自指更新会导致不稳定，故推导出稳定性匹配的步长控制：对自指注入施加软上限（soft cap）并对保留记忆转移施加谱裁剪（spectral clamp），证明记忆动态沿每次扫描为非扩张（non-expansive）。针对二维特征图，将 NL 的分块公式与图像行/列对齐，实施四个方向扫描。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K、COCO 与 ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的性能，验证自修改学习系统可作为通用视觉骨干的可行基础。

Conclusion: VisionHOPE 首次将自修改学习系统落地为通用视觉骨干，通过耦合记忆实现内容与学习规则的图像内共演化，并以软上限+谱裁剪的步长控制保证稳定性，为后续自修改视觉模型提供了实践基础。

Abstract: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.

</details>


### [193] [FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33330)
*Yuxuan Li,Yihang Chen,Yufeng Zhang,Jianfei Cai,Weiyao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FeCoSplat，一种面向前馈3DGS的反馈引导压缩框架：压缩多视角中间特征而非输入图像或高斯原语，利用一阶段渲染视图作为反馈指导二阶段压缩，接收端用轻量预测器从隐状态重建高斯原语，在低码率下取得较优率失真性能，重建仅需3.45M参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈3DGS虽能从稀疏多视角高效合成新视图，但其表示存储与传输开销大。现有方法或压缩输入图像（接收端重建负担重），或压缩已重建的高斯原语（属性异构、不规则，难以压缩）。因此需要一种在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间取得更佳平衡的方案。

Method: 压缩紧凑的中间特征，并以此为范式设计FeCoSplat框架：首先压缩多视角特征获得中间3DGS；用其渲染视图作为反馈，引导第二阶段压缩以进一步精化；所得码流解码为紧凑隐式状态，再由轻量预测器重建最终高斯原语。

Result: 实验表明FeCoSplat取得良好的率失真性能，尤其在低码率下优势明显；接收端高斯重建仅需3.45M参数。

Conclusion: 压缩中间特征可在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间实现更优权衡，反馈引导的两阶段压缩与轻量隐状态重建有效，FeCoSplat在低码率新视图合成中具有竞争力，代码将开源。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [194] [OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33338)
*Jingchen Ni,Yuji Wang,Shannan Yan,Haoru Li,Sitong Chen,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OPERA是一个基于单一MLLM的统一推理智能体，通过三个专门阶段进行双轴渐进式推理，实现异构多模态查询的指代视频分割，在OmniAVS和Ref-AVS上取得新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指代视频分割面临文本、音频、参考图像等异构多模态查询，需要同时具备鲁棒的跨模态理解与精确的时空推理能力，现有方法难以兼顾。

Method: 提出OPERA（Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent），构建于单一MLLM之上的统一推理智能体，执行双轴渐进式推理，包含三个专门阶段：时间轴上由Temporal Reasoning Agent通过粗到细过滤缩小帧搜索空间，定位信息量最大的关键帧；空间轴上由Distillation Agent通过跨模态语义蒸馏确定"定位什么"，由增强GRPO的Grounding Agent确定目标"出现在哪里"，并以密集掩码传播完成像素级输出。

Result: OPERA在OmniAVS和Ref-AVS基准上取得新的state-of-the-art，并能零样本迁移到标准指代视频分割基准。

Conclusion: 基于单一MLLM的双轴渐进式推理智能体设计，可有效统一处理异构多模态查询的指代视频分割任务，兼具高性能与零样本泛化能力。

Abstract: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.

</details>


### [195] [ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.33344)
*Heejoon Moon,Yurim Cho,Je Hyeong Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReLoc 提出改进的场景坐标回归架构，通过可学习上下文令牌+特征聚合器增强全局嵌入，并用注意力局部特征增强模块抑制噪声，实现高精度、实时的 LiDAR 定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 SCR 的 LiDAR 定位方法存在两个局限：(1) 依赖场景分类式的全局嵌入，难以对邻近位置进行细粒度区分；(2) 训练中对局部特征均匀采样，对所有点赋予相同权重，导致动态物体或不稳定区域的特征被传播，降低训练稳定性。

Method: ReLoc 进行两处重构：其一，重新设计全局嵌入模块，将可学习上下文令牌（learnable context tokens）与特征聚合器结合，以捕获更丰富、更具判别性的场景上下文；其二，引入基于注意力的局部特征增强模块，抑制噪声局部特征的影响，同时促进上下文一致的结构，获得更鲁棒的局部特征表示。

Result: 在两个大规模室外数据集上的实验表明，ReLoc 相比以往 SCR 方法达到最先进（state-of-the-art）的定位精度，同时保持实时推理性能。

Conclusion: ReLoc 通过全局嵌入与局部特征表示的双重改进，有效缓解了细粒度判别不足与噪声特征传播问题，验证了其在 LiDAR 定位中兼顾精度与效率的有效性。

Abstract: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context.
