Despite using only 400 synthetic training videos, OD-FT not only suppresses ordinal-matching bias but also improves audio-visual understanding on real-world videos, yielding average gains of 8.27\% for Qwen2.5-Omni and 2.57\% for video-SALMONN2+ across three audio-visual benchmarks.

</details>


### [265] [ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34231)
*Wangzhi Zhan,Jianpeng Chen,Dongqi Fu,Dawei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: REGDIFF：体素+潜空间调控+引导扩散的超材料几何生成框架，缓解合理性-新颖性权衡，平均提升合理性+8.9%、新颖性+46.4%、多样性+128.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超材料力学与物理行为主要由几何而非成分决定；体素表示能以统一立方离散格式表达桁架、壳、多孔等多类结构，但体素生成存在"合理性-新颖性"权衡：贴近已知几何可保持规则性，远离则有助于新颖却易产生退化几何。

Method: 提出 REGDIFF 生成框架，将体素表示与潜空间调控、引导扩散相结合；引入 repel-and-sink (RAS) 机制平滑合理几何的潜分布，并采用 short-range repulsion (SRR) 引导抑制生成样本过度接近已知几何，同时保持几何合理性。此外构建覆盖桁架型与壳型超材料几何的体素基准，并提供几何合理性、新颖性与多样性的评测模块。

Result: 在两个数据集上平均优于体素生成基线：几何合理性 +8.9%、新颖性 +46.4%、多样性 +128.6%。

Conclusion: REGDIFF 可作为下游评估的有效几何候选生成器，代码已开源（https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff）。

Abstract: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.

</details>


### [266] [Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34232)
*Zexi Jia,Zhiqiang Yuan,Jie Zhou,Jinchao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述认为，生成式系统使媒体外观不再能揭示其来源与修改历史，可信度须依赖可解释资产生成路径与使用情境的证据；证据可从媒体中恢复或在生产中记录并随资产流转保存，但需经受常规处理与刻意操纵的检验，且不存在普适的真实性标记。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像与视频长期帮助人们理解事件经过与作品形成过程，但生成式系统使逼真媒体可在不留稳定历史的情况下被生成和修改，外观无法再判断场景是被拍摄、合成还是中途改动，因此需要转向能够说明资产路径与使用情境的证据体系。

Method: 这是一篇综述性研究，将两类路径整合：一是从媒体本身恢复证据（如媒体取证、来源分析），二是在生产过程中记录并随资产流通保存的证据（如溯源元数据、内容凭证）。同时考察这些证据主张在经历常规处理或刻意操纵后是否仍然成立。

Result: 论文并非报告单一实验结果，而是提出分析框架与判断标准：不存在通用的真实性标志；证据必须与待回答的具体问题相匹配，能够到达实际作出判断的人，并在出现更好信息时保持可修正性。

Conclusion: 可信媒体的目标是在媒体本身不断变化的同时，保持其历史可被理解与追溯；这要求按问题选择适配证据、保证证据可及性并维持可纠正性。

Abstract: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.

</details>


### [267] [SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34235)
*Xiaoye Liang,Ye Yan,Mingze Yin,Shikun Feng,Mai Xu,Haiguang Liu,Lai Jiang,Yiheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的智能体式视觉生成框架SegBanana，利用冻结的统一多模态模型实现医学图像分割，在八个数据集上平均mDice达77.45%，显著超越通用与医学专用基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割在实际部署中面临两大难题：模型难以泛化到训练分布之外，且适配时往往缺乏高质量像素级标注。受大语言模型跨任务迁移能力的启发，作者希望探究统一多模态模型（UMMs）能否在无需任务特定后训练的情况下，将其预训练的视觉理解、推理与生成能力迁移至医学图像分割。

Method: 将分割重构为结构化视觉生成任务。首先发现前沿UMM（如Nano Banana）已具备基础分割能力，但在需要专门解剖或领域知识的困难任务上表现不足。据此提出SegBanana：以冻结的UMM为核心生成模型，引入解剖感知知识检索（Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval）与对比式质量评判（Comparative Quality Critique），并由状态感知多模态控制器（State-Aware Multimodal Controller）维护结构化状态、迭代编排工具、反复精炼掩码。同时采用上下文示例注入视觉解剖知识、重复采样扩展候选解、针对性编辑修正次优预测等策略。

Result: 在八个医学分割数据集上，SegBanana平均mDice达到77.45%，较代表性通用基线（SAM3、SegGPT）与医学专用基线（BiomedParse、MedSAM3）至少高出14.93个百分点，且对域外视觉支持保持稳健。

Conclusion: 统一多模态模型的预训练能力可有效迁移至医学图像分割，无需任务特定后训练。通过智能体式框架整合知识检索、质量评判与迭代精炼，能够显著提升分割性能与鲁棒性，为免训练医学图像分割提供了新范式。

Abstract: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted editing.Motivated by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.

</details>


### [268] [DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34237)
*Zheyuan Zhan,Can Wang,Jiawei Chen,Chun Chen,Siwei Lyu,Zeyu Zheng,Defang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DecFlowEdit，通过解耦流式生成模型中定位与编辑所需的最优引导尺度，在无需训练和反演的前提下显著改善背景保持效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FlowEdit默认的无分类器引导（CFG）配置采用非对称的源/目标引导尺度，导致严重的背景泄漏；而将二者尺度匹配（如移除CFG）虽能提升编辑相关区域的定位，却大幅降低可编辑性。作者希望同时兼顾定位与可编辑性。

Method: DecFlowEdit解耦定位与编辑的最优引导尺度：首先在无CFG条件下评估速度差并进行时间聚合，提取编辑相关先验；再用该先验对默认CFG下的原始更新进行重新加权。方法无需训练、无需反演，也不需要外部空间掩码或注意力操作。

Result: 在PIE-Bench上针对FLUX、SD3与SD3.5的实验表明，在编辑保真度相当的情况下，相比FlowEdit，DecFlowEdit将结构距离降低约61%至73%，背景LPIPS降低68%至80%。

Conclusion: 通过解耦引导尺度，DecFlowEdit在保持编辑能力的同时显著提升背景保持，验证了定位与编辑引导需求可分离这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.

</details>


### [269] [Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34271)
*Badi Li,Tianxin Huang,Yu Zhou,Wei-Shi Zheng,Yi Ma,Shenghua Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Alchemy3D统一框架，涵盖数据构建、模型架构与基准评测，用于可控3D资产编辑，包含Alchemy3D-1M数据集、生成式流模型家族及GEdit3D-Bench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D资产编辑方法受限于训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足，以及缺乏实用的评测协议。为突破这些限制，作者构建了覆盖数据、模型与评测的一体化框架。

Method: 构建Alchemy3D-1M大规模3D编辑数据集，含125万资产、138万编辑对，覆盖七种编辑类型；在该数据上训练一系列生成式流模型（generative flow models），支持图像与文本条件编辑、少步推理，并可迁移至多视角3D部件分割；同时提出GEdit3D-Bench开放世界基准与多维评测协议。

Result: 在现有及新引入的基准上，该方法在编辑保真度、源保持与视觉质量的大多数指标上均优于先前方法。

Conclusion: Alchemy3D通过数据、模型与评测三方面的统一设计，推动了通用且可控的3D资产编辑，并在多维指标上取得领先表现。

Abstract: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.

</details>


### [270] [See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34277)
*Chengyang Zhang,Wenchuan Zhang,Bo Li,Mengran Li,Xinyu Liu,Jiaming Yang,Jie Chen,Zhang Zhang,Yuhao Yi,Hong Bu,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ASPECT方法，通过对细胞外观与数量的显式监督提升病理视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，并构建PathoVernier基准暴露被答案准确率掩盖的中间观测错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理评估依赖对组织学图像细粒度视觉细节的识别，而现有视觉语言模型虽支持病理判读，但其细节感知能力不足，导致即使最终答案正确，中间细胞观测仍可能不准确。

Method: ASPECT通过病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐与计数监督来训练中间视觉token；采用三阶段监督微调使模型学会感知、生成视觉token与推理；随后用强化学习奖励答案正确性及与所报告测量的一致性。

Result: 构建PathoVernier基准，含来自五个病理数据集的759道专家审核问题，覆盖四类细胞组成任务，同时评估最终答案与中间测量。ASPECT相对最强基线Gemini-3.1-Pro准确率提升约19.2%，相对其Qwen3-VL-8B骨干提升99.3%，并将RAWR（衡量正确答案内计数错误）分别降低28.1%和42.7%。在三个外部病理基准上亦优于骨干模型。

Conclusion: 对细胞外观与数量的显式监督可有效提升病理视觉语言模型的视觉 grounded 推理，PathoVernier可揭示被答案准确率掩盖的误差，ASPECT在细胞组成及更广泛病理任务上均具优势。

Abstract: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

</details>


### [271] [Dexterous Tactile World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34286)
*Ziyao Zeng,Xiatao Sun,Hao Wang,Yueyang Pan,Zhengxiang Yu,Fengyu Yang,Tianyu Liu,Zhiwen Fan,Daniel Rakita*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DTWM，一种融合视觉与触觉的灵巧操作世界模型，通过在预训练视频扩散Transformer上以零初始化残差注入触觉信号，显著提升未来帧预测精度，尤其在长时预测中优势更明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯视觉世界模型难以观测决定操作进程的关键事件（如接触的建立与释放），而这些事件更易通过触觉感知；因此需要引入触觉信号来改善操作预测。

Method: 在预训练视频扩散Transformer上，将每只手的触觉信号通过零初始化残差注入到视频token中对应手部位置，并用因果掩码阻止预测帧访问未来信息；训练时同时使用视频和双手触觉手套信号。

Result: 相比架构、参数量与训练均匹配的纯视觉模型，DTWM将手部运动低估从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%（每种模型三次训练）；预测越靠后收益越大，后期chunk的改进约为首块的4.1倍；在相同设置下优于其他视觉-触觉世界模型，且推理时无触觉输入仍受益；消融显示模型同时受益于力的强度与空间位置，用二值接触状态替代会增大误差。

Conclusion: 触觉信号能有效增强操作世界模型的未来帧预测，力的量级与空间位置均重要，且力的变化过程可指示交互将持续还是改变。

Abstract: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

</details>


### [272] [Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34294)
*Duanning Chen,Ke He,Bin Yang,Yongxiang Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对无监督可见光-红外行人重识别（USL-VI-ReID）中跨模态身份对应不完整的问题，提出语义模态补偿框架SMC，通过提示组合解耦身份语义与模态风格，在缺失模态中合成语义对应体，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非配对（unpaired）设定下，跨模态身份对应关系常不完整，许多身份在另一模态中缺乏可观测的对应样本。现有非配对方法主要依赖视觉特征统计来生成或映射另一模态特征，未显式分离对身份具有判别性的内容与模态特有的风格，导致生成特征可能扭曲身份线索或继承源模态偏差，削弱跨模态监督的可靠性。

Method: 作者将非配对跨模态学习建模为语义补偿问题，提出基于提示组合（prompt composition）的语义模态补偿框架SMC，在共享视觉语义空间中解耦身份语义与模态风格。具体流程为：1）通过增强的双重对比学习构建判别性ReID空间，为每个模态生成伪标签、聚类原型与记忆库；2）在CLIP语义空间中学习可见光与红外模态提示，并将伪标签所得聚类映射为身份语义token；3）对在另一模态中缺乏可靠匹配的聚类，将其身份token与目标模态提示组合，合成该缺失模态的语义对应体；4）将合成对应体投影回ReID空间，并通过置信度门控注入补偿记忆库。

Result: 在配对与非配对两种设定下的大量实验表明，SMC持续优于当前最先进方法，尤其当身份错配严重时增益更为显著。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦身份语义与模态风格并在共享语义空间中合成缺失模态的语义对应体，SMC有效缓解了非配对USL-VI-ReID中的身份对应不完整问题，提升了跨模态监督的可靠性，在严重身份错配场景下具有突出优势。

Abstract: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.

</details>


### [273] [PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34299)
*Hongxu Ma,Guang Li,Shijie Wang,Dongzhan Zhou,Suorong Yang,Baoli Sun,Takahiro Ogawa,Miki Haseyama,Zhihui Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出精确统计匹配（PSM），按难度对蒸馏样本分组并施加难度特定监督，克服传统解耦统计匹配仅用全局平均统计、忽视样本难度的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解耦统计匹配方法显著降低蒸馏时间与内存开销且性能强，但它们通常用整个原始数据集估计的运行统计来监督所有蒸馏样本。这些统计主要刻画平均特征分布，忽视样本难度差异，难以表征原始数据的难度结构，从而限制匹配精度。

Method: PSM在预训练后使用全局精确度分数（GPS）估计图像难度，在每一类内排序样本，并将每类划分为IPC（每类图像数）个难度组。蒸馏时用统计再更新（SUA）通过对各组原始样本做前向传播更新教师BN运行统计，为对应蒸馏批次提供难度特定监督；同时用初始样本筛选（ISS）以对应难度组的原始图像初始化蒸馏样本，为精确匹配提供有效起点。

Result: 在多个数据集和模型架构上的实验表明，PSM拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围，并在大多数评估设置中提升了下游性能。代码将公开。

Conclusion: 按难度划分并施加难度特定统计监督可有效提升解耦统计匹配的蒸馏质量与下游性能，是一种时间与内存高效且性能更强的数据集蒸馏方案。

Abstract: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.

</details>


### [274] [CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34302)
*Taigo Sakai,Hiroki Kouno,Naoki Kato,Kazuhiro Hotta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAT-Free 是一种无需标定、无需位置标注、无需目标场景训练的多相机行人定位方法，仅依赖同步 RGB 视频，通过自适应几何滤波提升定位可靠性，并在多个数据集上实现良好 MODA，同时可用定位不确定性无标注地预测定位精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多相机行人定位适用于公共与商业空间的广域监测，但现有系统在新环境中部署时通常需要大量设置，例如相机标定、位置标注或目标场景训练。为消除这些场景特定依赖，作者提出无需上述三类先验的定位方案。

Method: CAT-Free 以同步 RGB 视频作为唯一场景特定输入：首先直接从视频估计相机配置；再融合多相机观测估计行人位置。针对自动相机估计不总是准确、可能导致位置不可靠的问题，引入两个自适应几何滤波器剔除不可靠位置估计，其阈值由每条输入序列估计得到。

Result: CAT-Free 在 WildTrack、MultiviewX 和 GMVD 上分别取得 82.5、84.5 和 65.7 MODA，且不使用提供的标定、位置标注或目标场景训练。使用场景特定信息的已发表方法在各自协议下报告 WildTrack 88.2--95.0 MODA、MultiviewX 83.9--96.5 MODA。CAT-Free 还可无需重新调参迁移，在四个额外序列上达到 74.9 MODA，在未见过的 8 相机装置上达到 78.6 MODA。此外，定位不确定性可预测 MODA，相关系数 r=-0.98，提供无标签的定位可靠性估计。

Conclusion: CAT-Free 去除了相机标定、位置标注和目标场景训练三项部署要求，仅凭同步 RGB 视频即可实现多相机行人定位，并通过自适应几何滤波和不确定性预测提升可靠性与可迁移性；其精度虽低于使用场景特定信息的协议，但显著降低了部署成本。

Abstract: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.

</details>


### [275] [MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34309)
*Haoyu Zhao,Zihao Zhang,Xudong Wang,Jiaxi Gu,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文定义"程序到视觉(P2V)差距"，提出MaLiang-Harness统一框架，将MLLM驱动的视觉生成组织为构建-检查-修订的持续过程，并在MaLiang-IBench/VBench上评测验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行程序虽能显式控制图像/视频构建方式，但生成可运行代码只是视觉创作的起点：程序可能正确执行却违背所要求的构图、外观或运动。作者将这种不一致定义为"程序到视觉(P2V)差距"，并指出需要系统性框架来研究MLLM如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果。

Method: 提出MaLiang-Harness统一框架，核心设计是让演化的视觉程序、其构建历史与验证共享同一修订参照。定义三项机制：持久可执行生成(PEG)状态，保存程序与任务上下文；可追踪生成过程(TGP)，将编辑与渲染证据相连；修订感知编辑与验证(REV)，支持恢复并在完成前检查当前修订。三者跨渲染后端协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。

Result: 在MaLiang-IBench上评测11个强闭源MLLM、在MaLiang-VBench上评测4个，衡量生成成功率、视觉质量与计算成本。GPT-6-Astra在两个基准上均达100%生成成功率，96.0%图像任务和76.9%视频任务满足全部质量阈值。对比还揭示通用能力分数与视觉生成表现之间存在错配，得分相近的模型在满足视觉需求的能力上差异显著。

Conclusion: MaLiang-Harness为研究MLLM如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果提供了系统基础，既揭示了可编程生成的潜力，也暴露了通用基准作为该能力预测指标的局限。项目已开源。

Abstract: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.

</details>


### [276] [PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34314)
*Shayekh Bin Islam,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PlaylistEval，一个无需人工标注的智能体框架，用于构建超过100小时播放列表的长视频理解评测基准，揭示前沿视频语言模型作为裁判时的可靠性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频语言模型越来越多被用作视频理解的裁判（评估模型输出、训练奖励模型），但当证据埋藏在长达一天的视频中时，其判断是否仍可靠尚无定论。现有基准无法回答这一问题：视频通常仅几分钟，许多问答对仅凭转录文本即可区分，且人工判定无法扩展到超长视频。

Method: PlaylistEval 框架自动生成带有配对答案的问题，答案差异由因果退化控制，使每一对都必须在整个集合中检索；构建覆盖七个领域（静态与动态知识）的630对基准，并在152对的子集上与人工判断对比验证。

Result: 在152对分层子集上与人工判断一致率为93.0%（IAA 0.781）；评测来自8个家族、17个全模态与多模态模型，前沿裁判模型仅达75.4%成对准确率，开源裁判模型差距更大；检索与最终判断均依赖多模态信息，且裁判准确率随播放列表规模扩大而下降。

Conclusion: PlaylistEval 首次系统评测超长视频场景下的视频语言裁判可靠性，表明当前模型在长上下文检索与多模态融合方面存在明显不足，并公开流水线、基准与评测代码。

Abstract: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.

</details>


### [277] [Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34319)
*Qianer Li,Chengjie Zhang,Jingwen Chen,Zanjia Tong,Jiyuan Zhang,Hong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练即插即用的文本-视觉协同令牌缓存框架TVCache，通过注意力头筛选与复用层选择加速VLA推理，在保持可比计算成本下显著提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型计算开销大，令牌缓存虽为免训练加速方案，但未充分利用文本-视觉协同这一关键归纳偏置，且忽视注意力聚合中头级可靠性与缓存复用中层间稳定性。

Method: TVCache为免训练框架：基于文本-视觉信息聚焦度筛选注意力头以增强任务相关且物理一致的视觉接地；并引入由文本-视觉熵差异引导的复用层选择机制，避免缓存不稳定表征、优化缓存资源分配。

Result: 在4种代表性VLA模型、2个仿真基准及真实机器人任务上验证有效性：相同令牌保留率下任务成功率持续优于现有VLA缓存方法，计算成本相当；OpenVLA-OFT上12.5%保留率时较VLA-Cache平均成功率提升最多14.5个百分点，FLOPs较全令牌推理降低2.45倍。

Conclusion: TVCache利用文本-视觉协同归纳偏置，通过头筛选与复用层选择实现高效且通用的VLA推理加速，兼具免训练、即插即用特性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.

</details>


### [278] [DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34325)
*Kaixuan He,Song Chen,Yi Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DORA 是一种面向冻结 ViT 的输入自适应动态 token 剪枝方法，将剪枝建模为有限时域 MDP，通过分层 actor 在线决定是否剪、剪多少及剪哪些 token，在 ImageNet-1K 上于精度损失约 1% 内减少 38.4% FLOPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT 自注意力计算量随 token 数呈二次增长。现有 token 缩减方法多依赖预设的逐层压缩计划来调整 token 身份，或离线搜索静态掩码，限制了在线自适应地决定何时剪枝与剪枝幅度。

Method: 提出 DORA（Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent），为冻结 ViT 学习输入自适应剪枝策略。在每个可选 block 中，分层 actor 针对每张图像不断演化的表示，决定是否剪枝、删除多少 token 以及删除哪些 token。由于早期删除会改变后续决策所观测的状态，将剪枝形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程。采用完整前缀影子评估（complete-prefix shadow evaluations）将最终预测保真度转化为逐步的局部信用，并用闭环精度反馈将保真度惩罚调节至共享的精度下降目标。特权 critic 与全部影子计算仅用于训练。部署时保留冻结主干与轻量 actor，执行硬删除及打包变长 FlashAttention，从而把 token 缩减转化为实际加速。

Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 与 DeiT-Base 上，DORA 相对未压缩主干减少 38.4% FLOPs，精度损失在一个百分点以内。在四个 ViT 类主干上按匹配精度平均，DORA 比各主干对应基线均值少用 13.2% FLOPs，吞吐量高 32.4%。零样本迁移到 ImageNet-A 时，增益分别扩大到 20.3% 与 45.6%。

Conclusion: DORA 通过强化学习实现冻结 ViT 的在线、输入自适应 token 剪枝，在保持精度竞争力的同时显著降低计算量并提升实际吞吐，且迁移场景下优势更明显。影子评估与特权 critic 仅在训练阶段使用，不增加部署开销。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.

</details>


### [279] [MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34330)
*Tinghao Wang,Yichen Guo,Qizhe Zhang,Yuan Zhang,Weimin Ouyang,Rui Huang,Jiajun Cao,Sixiang Chen,Hao Jiang,Jixian Wu,Zheng Lu,Bofan Zhu,Renyuan Li,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练无关的两阶段视觉token剪枝方法MiCo，基于互信息覆盖目标，在仅用5.6%视觉token时保留97.5%基线性能并实现3.8倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型处理大量视觉token导致高计算成本，现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式规则，容易在剪枝中丢弃大量视觉信息，造成性能下降。

Method: 借助语义擦除模型，从任务log-loss推导出通用的互信息覆盖目标。MiCo为训练无关的两阶段剪枝方法：视觉token进入语言模型前，先用视觉信号选取代表性候选池；再在其中进行任务感知的子集选择。每个阶段用合适的可观测代理将该目标实例化为单调次模覆盖函数，并在token预算下贪心优化。

Result: 在7B至13B参数的多种MLLM及涵盖通用视觉推理、细粒度OCR与定位、幻觉检测、长视频理解的众多图像和视频基准上评估，MiCo在几乎所有模型和所有剪枝比例下均取得最优性能。在LLaVA-NEXT-13B上仅用5.6%视觉token即保留97.5%基线性能，实现3.8倍推理加速。

Conclusion: 实验验证了MiCo及所提出的互信息覆盖目标在视觉token剪枝上的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.

</details>


### [280] [SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34335)
*Yanwei Huang,Mingxuan Zhu,Shujie Li,Shiyuan Liu,Yuanxing Zhang,Arpit Narechania*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SkillPE 提出一种提示工程框架，从专家撰写的种子提示中演化出可复用的电影化技能库，通过谐振、失谐与发散三类电影参考检索与四维视频评估，在 StoryEval 和 VBench 上提升生成视频的提示保真度与电影感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非专业用户的提示词往往缺乏专业叙事与创意设计，难以生成高质量、电影级的文本到视频结果。

Method: SkillPE 以细粒度格式表示镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计等电影语言线索；检索电影参考并分为谐振（强匹配）、失谐（弱匹配）与发散（有创意价值的近似偏差）；前两类用于细化技能的适用时机与方式，发散类用于在保持用户意图下激发不同修改程度的替代性电影化实现；候选技能通过生成视频在提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力与创造力四个维度上评估，最终构建技能库。

Result: 在 StoryEval 与 VBench 上，7 分制四维评估中较最强外部基线最高提升 1.40 分，较种子技能提升 0.51 分，同时在基准原生指标上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: SkillPE 为电影化文本到视频生成中平衡保真度与创造力提供了一种实用方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .

</details>


### [281] [E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34346)
*Jiale Wu,Xiaoyang Bai,Haoming Yu,Yiwei Chen,Yifan Peng,Weiwei Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: E-WAVE：面向事件流高时间分辨率光流的无相关性体框架，用全局注意力与贝塞尔轨迹引导变形实现任意时刻查询，精度可比且轨迹误差降25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式VR/AR需要连续、时间密集的光流以跟踪快速头、手与物体运动。帧基方法受时间分辨率与计算成本的权衡限制；事件相机具备高时间分辨率与低能耗，成为自然解法，但现有事件方法依赖相关性体（correlation volumes）建模逐对体素对应，带来显著内存与计算开销。

Method: 提出E-WAVE，一种无相关性的高时间分辨率光流估计框架。不做全对相关性体，而是用全局注意力机制建模长程特征依赖；采用贝塞尔曲线进行轨迹引导的特征变形（warping）；通过迭代更新预测轨迹，从而支持在任意时间戳查询而无需重复推理。

Result: 在MultiFlow与DSEC-Flow上，相比SOTA基线轨迹误差降低约25%，端点光流估计精度相当；在自采集数据上的头戴原型评测验证其在挑战性真实环境下仍具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: E-WAVE以无相关性体设计在降低内存与计算开销的同时实现高时间分辨率光流，兼顾轨迹精度与端到端精度，并具备真实场景鲁棒性，适用于VR/AR动态感知。

Abstract: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.

</details>


### [282] [SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34363)
*Zelong Xu,Yan Li,Wenhe Hu,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文诊断全模态模型在音视频时间对应上的缺陷（通过时间交换实验验证答案不随配对变化），提出轻量方法SyncRA，用对比学习对齐中间音频-视觉表示，无需额外标注且推理不变；在4个全模态模型、5个视频基准上稳定超越仅答案微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态模型对音频和视觉输入的感知能力较强，但难以在"同一时刻"听到与看到的内容之间建立联系。这种时间对应能力的缺失会使模型将语音线索关联到错误的视觉场景，产生看似合理却基于错误音视频配对的答案。

Method: 提出Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment（SyncRA），一种强化音频-视觉时间对应关系的轻量方法。具体地，SyncRA在每个视频内部对中间层音频-视觉表示做对比学习：拉近匹配时刻的表示、推开不匹配时刻的表示，从而在共享的全局上下文中捕获局部时间对应。监督信号直接来自输入本身的时间信息，无需额外标注，且不改变推理流程。

Result: 在4个不同规模与架构的开源全模态模型、5个公开视频基准上进行评测。SyncRA在所有"模型×基准"组合上一致优于仅答案微调（answer-only fine-tuning），同时在受控评测中显著提升了跟踪音视频配对变化的能力。

Conclusion: 轻量、针对性的监督可以有效强化音视频时间对应能力，并转化为音视频问答任务的广泛性能提升。

Abstract: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

</details>


### [283] [Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34367)
*Yulong Cheng,Youneng Bao,Junfeng Zhou,Mu Li,Jie Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OIC-GS：基于HEALPix分层网格的全向高斯泼溅编解码器，无需坐标编码，支持全向/视口/渐进解码，视口解码52%码流即达最终质量并实现1270 FPS渲染，率失真优于现有GS编解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沉浸式VR对解码速度与重建质量均有高要求：学习图像编解码器（LIC）质量高但解码慢；高斯泼溅（GS）编解码器渲染快但重建质量落后，且图元分配通常未考虑每个图元的编码代价。

Method: 提出OIC-GS全向GS编解码器，采用新的分层HEALPix图元网格表示：高斯图元锚定在预定义球面位置，消除显式坐标编码；细层级细化粗层级祖先，天然支持粗到细重建与分层传输；预定义网格便于仅选取视口相关图元实现高效视口解码。还为量化图元引入轻量熵模型，并在球面率失真目标下优化编解码器。量化不透明度为零且率失真收益不足的图元被自动移除，从而自适应图元密度与细节层级，无需固定图元预算。单一码流支持全向、视口相关与渐进解码。

Result: 首个视口仅需解码52%码流即达最终质量，随后以1270 FPS渲染；在100图全向基准上优于所有评估的GS编解码器，相比GaussianImage++降低WS-PSNR BD-rate 49.6%，相比使用学习熵模型的SGI降低68.6%。

Conclusion: OIC-GS通过分层HEALPix锚定网格与率失真驱动的图元自适应，在不牺牲重建质量的前提下显著提升全向VR场景的解码与渲染效率，并统一支持全向、视口依赖和渐进三种解码模式。

Abstract: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.

</details>


### [284] [From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34371)
*Bingqing Jiang,Li Luo,Zichao Yu,Yujin Han,Zhaolong Su,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MILD框架，用图像专家替代视频专家，通过可学习线性连接器在异构隐空间中实现图像到视频的潜在蒸馏，结合预训练动态约束与光流运动奖励，在多种专家和骨干上优于视频教师OPD基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）通常依赖大型视频教师，但训练专用视频专家需昂贵视频数据与算力，且推理延迟远高于图像专家。图像专家更易获取、查询成本低，尤其适合美学、OCR等时间无关的帧级能力。然而异构的图像/视频隐空间阻碍对中间学生状态的直接监督，且图像专家缺乏跨帧运动监督，帧级提升易损害时间一致性。

Method: MILD（Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation）：1）采用可学习线性连接器，将学生隐状态与预测更新对齐到图像专家的对应量，实现跨异构隐空间的监督迁移；2）将图像引导的修正约束在预训练学生预测附近，以保留视频动态；3）引入基于光流的运动奖励，提升运动质量与时间一致性。

Result: 在多种专用图像专家与多个视频学生骨干上，方法稳定优于视频教师OPD基线；消融研究显示在不同连接器设计与异构架构间均能有效迁移。

Conclusion: 图像到视频蒸馏是提升视频生成的有效路径，可借助图像生成生态多样且不断演进的能力，规避视频教师的高成本与高延迟。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

</details>


### [285] [Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34378)
*Zhang Ruiyang,Ou Jinpeng,Xie Yifan,Zhou Jingang,Pan Lirui,Guo Qingpei,Zheng Zhedong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Marathoner，一种具备超长时程执行能力的自主智能体模型，通过完整的后训练流水线（任务合成、拒绝采样微调、强化学习）赋予基座模型数月乃至数年持续工作的能力，在5个基准上显著超越基座模型甚至强专有模型，可连续工作10+小时、调用工具1000+次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能针对长期目标持续工作数月甚至数年，而现有智能体模型缺乏这种"超长时程执行"能力。作者希望将这一关键能力灌输给基座模型，使其能自主、持续地完成高难度长期任务。

Method: 提出Marathoner及完整后训练流水线：（1）超长时程任务合成——利用GitHub多仓库中新增1000+行代码的重大发布PR作为任务级数据来源；（2）多任务链式拼接（Multi-Task Chaining）——将多个生成任务串联为单一更高难度任务，合成前沿级难度任务；（3）拒绝采样微调——用强教师模型配合多种harness在合成任务上生成轨迹，对基座模型做监督微调；（4）强化学习——冷启动模型在独立沙箱中通过harness进行真实执行，并提出新奖励策略"Later Stage Bonus Reward"，显式鼓励模型在执行后期阶段执行有意义的关键操作。

Result: 在包含超长时程任务的5个基准上，Marathoner相较基座模型取得一致且显著提升，甚至超越强专有模型的表现；进一步分析显示，Marathoner能在高难度任务上持续工作10+小时并进行1000+次工具调用。

Conclusion: 通过任务合成、拒绝采样微调与强化学习的组合后训练，可有效赋予基座模型真实的超长时程执行能力，Marathoner验证了这一路径的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories. For reinforcement learning, cold-started model performs real-world execution through harnesses in independent sandboxes during rollout process, effectively facilitating the acquisition of genuine ultra-long-horizon execution capability. We further propose a novel reward strategy, Later Stage Bonus Reward, which explicitly encourages model to perform meaningful maneuvers during later stages of execution. Through extensive evaluation on 5 benchmarks containing ultra-long-horizon tasks, Marathoner achieves consistent and substantial performance improvements over base model and even surpasses performance of strong proprietary model. Further analysis shows that Marathoner can consistently work for 10+ hours and conduct 1000+ tool calls on highly challenging tasks.

</details>


### [286] [Joint and Cross-Modal Video-Audio Generation and Editing: A Unified Formulation and Design Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34381)
*Abhinav Sharma,Sai Karthik Navuluru,Wang Wei,Daksh Dangi,Xiangbo Gao,Li Li,Bo Ni,Vardhan Dongre,Junda Wu,Xiyang Hu,Jiuxiang Gu,Seunghyun Yoon,Tong Yu,Chien Van Nguyen,Mohamed Elmoghany,Nedim Lipka,Hoda Eldardiry,Hongjie Chen,Tyler Derr,Thien Huu Nguyen,Zhengzhong Tu,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了音视频联合生成与编辑方法，围绕跨模态时空语义一致性这一核心问题，提出统一概率分布框架与五维设计分类法，并首次系统分类了涵盖9类编辑、28种编辑类型的音视频联合编辑任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频与音频在感知上是一体的，但现有大多数生成模型将二者孤立处理，缺乏对跨模态一致性的统一建模与系统梳理，尤其音视频联合编辑领域尚无系统性综述。

Method: 提出统一形式化表述，将联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑统一为定义在音视频对联合分布上的三类问题；构建沿五个设计维度比较方法的分类法；对每种设置梳理方法、数据集与评价指标；并将联合编辑映射为9类编辑类别、28种编辑类型。

Result: 形成了一个跨音视频联合生成、跨模态生成与联合编辑的统一分析框架与分类体系，覆盖各设置下的方法、数据集和度量指标，并给出了九类编辑、28种编辑类型的编辑分类映射。

Conclusion: 这是首个对音视频联合编辑进行系统分类的综述；论文指出跨模态一致性是核心组织线索，并总结了该领域最具重要性的开放问题。

Abstract: Video and audio are perceived together, yet most generative models treat them in isolation. We examine methods that model the two modalities jointly, generate one from the other, or edit them in a coupled manner, organized around a single question: how is the output kept coherent across modalities in time and semantics? A unified formulation casts joint generation, cross-modal generation, and joint editing as three problems defined on a single distribution over audio-visual pairs, and a taxonomy compares methods along five design axes. To our knowledge, this is the first overview to systematically taxonomize joint audio-visual editing, which we map as nine edit categories spanning 28 edit types. We describe methods, datasets, and metrics for each setting and close with the open problems we view as most consequential.

</details>


### [287] [CAR-VLA: Complexity-Aware and Risk-Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34387)
*Xiaolei Chen,Zhuolin He,Yuxuan Liang,Xu Li,Haotian Chen,Shi Fan,Mengyang Zhao,Wenjuan Meng,Zisheng Chen,Zhihao Zhu,Zhounan Jin,Hengli Wang,Qingfan Wang,Jiamei Liang,Bin Li,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CAR-VLA：联合场景复杂度与动态风险的驾驶VLA自适应推理模型


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶VLA自适应推理方法仅关注"是否推理"，忽略了不同驾驶场景下"如何推理"的差异。作者指出，场景复杂度决定推理深度，而动态风险对时间紧迫场景下的推理方式同样关键。

Method: 提出CAR-VLA统一驾驶VLA模型，联合考虑场景复杂度与动态风险来引导推理深度、紧迫性与关注点。将四类复杂度—风险组合映射为三种推理模式：简单低风险场景用Fast Intuition直接生成轨迹，复杂低风险场景用Slow Thinking审慎推理，高风险场景（无论复杂度）用Reflex Response进行聚焦险情的紧凑推理。训练采用渐进式监督学习（关联场景评估、推理模式选择与轨迹生成），随后用推理增强的强化学习提升驾驶质量与推理行为。

Result: 在NAVSIM v1上获得91.1 PDMS，NAVSIM v2上90.3 EPDMS，Navhard上35.0 EPDMS，展现有竞争力的驾驶性能；在navtest与内部高风险场景的定性比较进一步展示了风险感知推理与险情响应式轨迹生成。

Conclusion: 通过将动态风险纳入推理模式决策，CAR-VLA实现了风险感知的自适应推理与轨迹生成，并在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能，代码将公开。

Abstract: Existing adaptive reasoning methods for driving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models primarily focus on whether to reason, overlooking how reasoning should differ across driving situations. Our key insight is that while scene complexity informs reasoning depth, dynamic risk is equally critical for deciding how to reason in time-critical situations. We therefore propose CAR-VLA, a unified driving VLA model that jointly considers scene complexity and dynamic risk to guide reasoning depth, urgency, and focus. CAR-VLA maps four complexity--risk categories to three reasoning modes: \textit{Fast Intuition} for direct trajectory generation in simple low-risk scenes, \textit{Slow Thinking} for deliberate reasoning in complex low-risk scenes, and \textit{Reflex Response} for compact, hazard-focused reasoning in high-risk scenes regardless of complexity. Rather than merely shortening deliberation, Reflex Response centers reasoning on the most critical hazard and the immediate safe response. We train CAR-VLA through progressive supervised learning that links scene assessment, reasoning-mode selection, and trajectory generation, followed by reasoning-augmented reinforcement learning to improve driving quality and reasoning behavior. Experiments on NAVSIM v1(91.1 PDMS), NAVSIM v2(90.3 EPDMS), and Navhard(35.0 EPDMS) demonstrate competitive driving performance. Qualitative comparisons on navtest and in-house high-risk scenarios further illustrate risk-aware reasoning and hazard-responsive trajectory generation. The code for this paper will be released publicly at: https://github.com/chenxl124578/CAR-VLA.git

</details>


### [288] [VastMAT: A Large-Scale Multi-Category Benchmark for Multi-Animal Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34390)
*Zhizhen Li,Zan Wang,Huidong Peng,Bohan Tan,Shimin Shan,Yu Liu,Liang Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出大规模多动物跟踪基准VastMAT，含2947个视频、100余万标注帧、337个动物类别，并设立可见/未见类别两种评估协议；针对低重叠关联难题提出轻量模块CDA，无需额外训练即可提升HOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多目标跟踪基准主要面向行人和车辆，而专门的多动物跟踪基准在动物覆盖广度、大规模视频数据和视频内多实例关联规模方面存在不足，难以支撑动物运动、行为与群体交互研究。

Method: 构建VastMAT基准：2947个视频、1,002,562个标注帧、27.85小时、337个动物类别，提供3,663,248个边界框和22,883条身份轨迹，标注经迭代专家审核与独立重标注审计。建立Seen-category与类别不相交的Unseen-category两种评估协议。提出Center-Distance-Augmented Association（CDA）轻量模块，自适应结合IoU与按框自身尺度归一化的中心相似度。

Result: 在两种协议下评估八种代表性MOT方法，最高基线HOTA分别为66.37%和52.90%，显示未见动物跟踪的难度。CDA在无需额外训练的情况下，将TrackTrack的HOTA在两种协议下分别提升1.58和1.31个百分点。

Conclusion: VastMAT在规模、类别覆盖、实例标注数量和标注质量上均具优势，且通过Unseen协议揭示了跨类别泛化挑战；CDA有效缓解低重叠关联问题，基准与代码将公开以促进多动物跟踪研究。

Abstract: Multi-animal tracking (MAT) supports the study of animal movement, behavior, and group interactions. However, general multi-object tracking (MOT) benchmarks primarily focus on pedestrians and vehicles, whereas dedicated MAT benchmarks remain limited in jointly supporting broad animal coverage, large-scale video data, and extensive within-video multi-instance association. To address this gap, we introduce VastMAT, which has four key characteristics: (1) Large scale. It comprises 2,947 videos with 1,002,562 annotated frames, totaling 27.85 hours. (2) Broad category coverage. These videos cover 337 animal categories with diverse morphologies and motion patterns. (3) Extensive instance annotations. It provides 3,663,248 bounding boxes and 22,883 identity trajectories---to our knowledge, the largest numbers of both among dedicated MAT benchmarks. (4) High-quality annotations. To ensure reliability, annotations undergo iterative expert review and correction, and quality is assessed through an independent reannotation audit. To systematically assess tracking performance and cross-category generalization, we establish Seen-category and category-disjoint Unseen-category protocols, and evaluate eight representative MOT methods under both protocols. Under these protocols, the highest baseline HOTA scores are 66.37\% and 52.90\%, respectively, highlighting the challenge of tracking unseen animals. To address the low-overlap association challenge revealed by our analysis, we propose Center-Distance-Augmented Association (CDA), a lightweight module that adaptively combines IoU with center similarity normalized by the boxes' own scales. Without additional training, CDA improves TrackTrack's HOTA by 1.58 and 1.31 percentage points under the two protocols, respectively. To facilitate further MAT research, we will publicly release our benchmark and code.

</details>


### [289] [HyperDAM: Hyperspectral Distractor-Aware Memory with Amodal Expansion for SAM 3 Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34396)
*Ryoga Yuzawa,Tasuku Takagi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperDAM，一个基于 DAM4SAM3 的高光谱视频跟踪器，通过模态掩码标注、高光谱门控记忆更新与因果时空扩展三项改进，在 HOTC 2026 竞赛中取得第二名（AUC 68.0093%、DP@20 87.7703%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高光谱视频能提供材质线索，可区分伪彩色外观相似的目标，但现有基础模型跟踪器主要依赖空间与外观证据更新记忆，未能充分利用光谱信息，导致在相似干扰物与遮挡场景下易发生目标漂移与切换。

Method: 方法包含三项核心贡献：1) 构建 HOTC2026-Modal 数据集，为全部 481 段视频补充人工核验的逐帧模态掩码与紧贴掩码的边界框；2) 提出帧零校准的 HSI 门控，拒绝对光谱不一致的记忆更新（针对干扰物消解记忆 DRM），且不影响当前预测；3) 设计因果时空扩展器，从冻结的 SAM 特征生成仅向外的非模态修正；并采用静态场景恢复与空掩码 RTS 平滑处理目标切换与完全遮挡；模型选择以跨域鲁棒性优先而非排行榜特定优化。

Result: 最终系统在 HOTC 2026 官方私有评测中排名第二，取得 68.0093% AUC 与 87.7703% DP@20 的成绩。

Conclusion: 通过引入高光谱模态信息对记忆更新进行门控并辅以因果时空扩展与后处理平滑，可在基础模型跟踪框架下有效提升相似目标与遮挡场景的跟踪鲁棒性，验证了光谱线索与跨域泛化优先策略的有效性。

Abstract: Hyperspectral video provides material cues that can disambiguate targets with similar false-color appearance, yet foundation-model trackers update memory primarily from spatial and appearance evidence. We present HyperDAM, a DAM4SAM3-based hyperspectral tracker with three principal contributions. First, HOTC2026-Modal adds human-verified frame-wise modal masks and mask-tight boxes to all 481 organizer-provided HOTC 2026 videos. Second, a frame-zero-calibrated HSI gate rejects spectrally inconsistent updates to the distractor-resolving memory (DRM) without altering the current prediction. Third, a causal spatiotemporal expander adds outward-only amodal corrections from frozen SAM features. Static-scene recovery and empty-mask RTS smoothing address target switches and full occlusion. Model selection prioritizes cross-domain robustness over leaderboard-specific optimization. The final system ranked second in HOTC 2026, achieving 68.0093% AUC and 87.7703% DP@20 in the organizer's private evaluation.

</details>


### [290] [Distilling Visual Reasoning into Text Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34408)
*Wenhan Yang,Nilay Naharas,Ali Payani,Baharan Mirzasoleiman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出V2T框架，通过知识蒸馏让LVLM内化视觉推理能力，推理时无需生成中间视觉表示，在多个基准上超越教师与基线，平均准确率提升14.3%，训练速度最高快42倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM在多模态推理上表现优异，但在需要图像外概念的任务上表现不佳。现有方法通过生成中间图像或潜在视觉token来引导推理，但这些表示会引入错误，且随推理推进对文本推理的干扰日益加剧。

Method: V2T先训练一个使用交错视觉与文本思维链的教师LVLM；再用知识蒸馏训练学生LVLM，利用教师logits和真实文本推理的交叉熵监督。当推理图像可映射到原图时，还可蒸馏教师对相应区域的注意力，真实边界框可进一步引导后续强化学习阶段。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，V2T持续超越教师模型和现有基线：在保留集上平均准确率提升14.3%，在更广泛的视觉评测套件上提升2.7%。同时，轻量级SFT与大幅缩减的RL使V2T训练速度比最先进基线快达42倍。

Conclusion: V2T通过蒸馏将视觉推理内化到LVLM中，推理时无需生成中间视觉表示，既避免了表示误差与干扰，又显著提升了准确率与训练效率。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong promise for multimodal reasoning, yet often struggle with tasks requiring concepts beyond what is directly observable in the input image. Existing methods generate intermediate images or latent visual tokens to guide reasoning, but these representations can introduce errors and increasingly interfere with textual reasoning as reasoning progresses. We propose Visual-to-Text Chain-of-Thought Distillation (V2T), a framework that enables LVLMs to internalize visual reasoning without generating intermediate visual representations at inference time. V2T first trains a teacher LVLM using interleaved visual and textual chains of thought, and then uses knowledge distillation to train a student LVLM using the teacher's logits and cross-entropy supervision from ground-truth textual reasoning. When reasoning images can be mapped to the original image, V2T can additionally distill the teacher's attention to corresponding regions, while ground-truth bounding boxes can further guide a subsequent reinforcement learning stage. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that V2T consistently outperforms the teacher and existing baselines, improving average accuracy by 14.3% on a held-out set and 2.7% on the broader visual evaluation suite. Moreover, lightweight SFT and substantially reduced RL make V2T up to 42x faster to train than state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [291] [HUMAN-TCI: Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network with Torso-Centered Interaction for Text-to-Motion Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34430)
*Muhammad Islam,Euijoon Ahn,Usman Naseem,Tao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 HUMAN-TCI，一种分层多流运动感知网络，用于文本引导的人体运动检索，通过三流架构显式建模上下肢与躯干运动的交互，兼顾简单与复杂多动作描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本引导的人体运动检索是运动建模与合成的重要前置步骤，可从大规模数据集中选取语义相关序列并为下游任务提供参考。然而，现有方法多针对单一动作的简单描述，通常独立处理各身体部位或仅拼接特征，未显式建模躯干运动对其他部位的影响；且依赖计算量大的模型，在长序列或复杂运动上开销显著，限制了判别性运动模式表示的学习，降低检索精度、可解释性与效率。

Method: 提出 HUMAN-TCI，一种分层多流运动感知网络。采用三流架构，分别建模上肢、下肢与躯干运动，并显式捕捉三者之间的交互，使躯干相关运动能够影响其他身体部位的定位与动态；引入定制的躯干注意力机制，以识别复杂人体运动模式并捕捉细粒度运动关系。

Result: 能够有效识别复杂人体运动模式，捕捉细粒度运动关系，并处理复杂多动作描述；支持对简单单动作句子以及包含顺序或重叠动作的长组合式描述进行检索，且不依赖复杂模型。

Conclusion: HUMAN-TCI 通过三流交互建模与躯干注意力，缓解了现有方法在复杂多动作描述、躯干影响建模及计算开销方面的局限，提升了文本引导人体运动检索的精度、可解释性与效率。

Abstract: Accurate retrieval of human motions is a crucial first step in text-guided human motion modeling and synthesis, as it selects semantically relevant sequences from large datasets and provides grounded references for downstream tasks. Retrieving motions from natural language descriptions remains challenging because sentences can describe multiple actions, overlapping movements, and intricate dependencies between body parts. Existing methods often focus on simple, single-action descriptions and typically process body parts independently or by merely concatenating features, without explicitly modeling how torso movements influence other parts. In addition, their processing pipelines often rely on computationally heavy models, introducing considerable overhead, particularly when modeling longer or more complex motion sequences. This limits learning discriminative motion-pattern representations, reducing retrieval accuracy, interpretability, and efficiency in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose HUMAN-TCI, a Hierarchical Multi-Stream Motion-Aware Network for text-guided human motion retrieval. HUMAN-TCI employs a three-stream architecture that separately models upper-body, lower-body, and torso motions while explicitly capturing their interactions, allowing torso-related movements to influence the positioning and dynamics of other body parts. By incorporating tailored torso attention, our model effectively recognizes complex human motion patterns, captures fine-grained motion relationships and handles complex multi-action descriptions. Our framework supports retrieval for both simple, single-action sentences and long, compositional descriptions containing sequential or overlapping actions without relying on complex models.

</details>


### [292] [Clinical Trajectory Alignment for Medical Vision-Language Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34439)
*Huimin Yan,Xian Yang,Zhi Wang,Liang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MedCTA，将医学视觉-语言预训练从就诊级跨模态匹配重构为"临床变化学习"，在"异常"和"患者病程"两个互补尺度上建模纵向变化语义，并通过离线 LLM 解析器自动提取结构化趋势监督，在多项任务上超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉-语言预训练普遍采用就诊级图像-报告匹配范式，仅对齐单次就诊的成对图像与报告，擅长静态跨模态对应，但对纵向临床变化（异常是好转、稳定还是恶化）监督不足。学习此类变化存在两大困难：一是时间语义隐含在自由文本报告中，二是同一患者的不同异常可能异步演化甚至方向相反。

Method: 提出 MedCTA，将预训练目标由就诊级跨模态匹配改为临床变化学习，不把患者病史压缩为单一时间表示，而是在两个互补尺度建模：1）异常尺度——用具有临床依据的查询构建"以异常为条件"的视觉与文本轨迹，刻画异质性的异常演化；2）患者病程尺度——对全局图像序列与报告序列建模，捕捉超越单个异常的整体临床进展。此外，使用离线 LLM 解析器从纵向报告中自动提取结构化趋势监督，免去人工时间标注；并将其与静态图像-报告对齐结合，使表示既保留就诊级跨模态对应，又编码纵向变化语义。

Result: 在时序图像分类、图像-文本检索和零样本分类任务上，MedCTA 相较强医学视觉-语言基线均取得一致性提升。

Conclusion: 以临床变化为中心、多尺度建模纵向语义，并借助 LLM 自动获取趋势监督，是提升医学视觉-语言表示对时间演化刻画能力的有效途径，且无需人工时间标注。

Abstract: Medical vision-language pre-training largely follows a visit-level image-report matching paradigm, aligning paired images and reports at individual visits. While effective for static cross-modal correspondence, this paradigm provides limited supervision for longitudinal clinical change, such as whether abnormalities improve, remain stable, or worsen over time. Learning such change is challenging because temporal semantics are implicit in free-text reports, and different abnormalities within the same patient may evolve asynchronously or even in opposite directions. We propose MedCTA, which reframes medical vision-language pre-training from visit-level cross-modal matching to learning clinical change. Rather than compressing a patient history into a single temporal representation, MedCTA models clinical change at two complementary scopes. At the abnormality scope, clinically grounded queries construct abnormality-conditioned visual and textual trajectories to capture heterogeneous abnormality evolution. At the patient-course scope, global image and report sequences are modeled to capture overall clinical progression beyond any individual abnormality. Structured trend supervision is extracted from longitudinal reports by an offline LLM parser, removing the need for manual temporal annotations. Combined with static image-report alignment, MedCTA learns representations that preserve visit-level cross-modal correspondence while encoding longitudinal change semantics. Experiments on temporal image classification, image-text retrieval, and zero-shot classification show consistent gains over strong medical vision-language baselines.

</details>


### [293] [Can Attack Difficulty Be Characterized Before Optimization? A Study of Pre-optimization Difficulty in Person-Vanishing Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34501)
*Jingyao Xu,Dongdong Wang,Siyang Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"优化前攻击难度"概念，设计基于几何二次近似的估计器Quad-CLEVER，在优化开始前预测行人消失攻击的难度，并据此构建难度感知攻击框架，在固定算力预算下提升攻击成功率并降低优化成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对抗攻击研究从优化视角出发，将攻击难度视为优化完成后才能观测到的结果，缺乏对不同输入固有攻击难度差异的事前刻画。作者由此提出核心问题：不同输入的相对攻击难度能否在优化开始前被刻画。

Method: 针对行人消失攻击，作者定义"优化前攻击难度"以刻画不同输入图像在优化代价上的内在差异，并提出Quad-CLEVER估计器：沿最具攻击相关性的方向对局部行人消失margin进行二次近似，从而以几何方式高效估计该潜在难度。进一步构建难度感知攻击框架，利用估计难度在固定算力预算下自适应分配基础攻击的优化预算。

Result: 在多种攻击算法上的实验表明，Quad-CLEVER与观测到的优化代价持续相关，证明攻击难度具有可预测的优化前结构。在BDD100K上，所提框架将图像级攻击成功率最高提升5.78%，同时平均优化代价最多减少11.42次迭代；在更具挑战性的EventPed数据集上，节省2.25次优化迭代并保持可比的攻击性能。

Conclusion: 攻击难度可在优化前被有意义地估计，且利用该估计可实现更高效计算的对抗攻击，为对抗攻击难度的事前建模与算力自适应分配提供了新思路。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks against object detectors are traditionally studied from an optimization perspective, where attack difficulty is regarded as an outcome observed only after adversarial optimization. This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [294] [SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34502)
*Xinyu Wang,Huafeng Shi,Zian Li,Yan Zhou,Xiaoqiang Liu,Yue Ma,Pengfei Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SubjectAnchor 提出一种主体感知的“记忆到视频”范式，通过显式视觉记忆条件化生成当前镜头，在多镜头叙事中保持主体身份与场景一致性，同时保留逐镜头提示的可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多镜头叙事生成中，跨镜头切换时主体的身份和场景一致性容易丢失，同时需要保持逐镜头提示驱动的可控性。现有记忆类或整体式基线在跨镜头身份一致性上表现不足。

Method: 基于 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 构建，包含三个关键组件：（1）主体相关记忆构建：为每个目标镜头将所需主体追溯至其历史出现，检索最相关的预计算关键帧，构成紧凑记忆库，并作为显式视觉条件编码进模型输入；（2）主体感知时间旋转位置编码：将不同主体分配到相互分离的负向时间槽，以减少身份干扰；（3）记忆感知注意力划分：在共享主干内调控记忆 token 与生成内容之间的交互。

Result: 实验表明，与代表性的记忆类方法和整体式基线相比，SubjectAnchor 提升了跨镜头身份一致性，同时保持了有竞争力的视觉质量。

Conclusion: SubjectAnchor 在保留显式视觉记忆的外观锚定能力的同时，兼容脚本驱动的逐镜头生成，为实现跨镜头一致的多镜头叙事视频生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.

</details>


### [295] [XFlow: A Workflow Model for Instruction-Guided Lesion Segmentation in Chest X-rays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34513)
*Geon Choi,Hangyul Yoon,Hyunki Park,Sang Hoon Seo,Edward Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XFlow是一种用于指令引导病灶分割(ILS)的工作流模型，模仿放射科医生由粗到细的多级感知过程，先定位肺与病灶框，再通过多轮点提示细化SAM掩膜，在内部和外部评估中均取得最佳分割质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部X光(CXR)文本引导分割模型仅覆盖少量解剖结构与病灶，且大多假设查询目标必然存在。ILS任务被提出以分割多样病灶并识别病灶缺失，首模型ROSALIA虽解决了这些局限，但其掩膜质量有限、常带散乱噪声，且采用单次推理，与放射科医生"先整体巡视胸腔、再定位异常区域、最后细化轮廓"的多级感知过程根本不同。

Method: 提出XFlow工作流模型，结合基于框的定位与多轮点细化：先检测左右肺，判断查询病灶是否存在于各肺中，用病灶框提示微调后的SAM生成初始掩膜，再通过点提示迭代校正掩膜边界直至贴合病灶，且每个中间决策均可见。

Result: 在内部与外部评估中均取得最佳分割质量；即使与ROSALIA在相同病灶标注上训练，XFlow的分割质量仍优于ROSALIA。代码与模型权重将公开。

Conclusion: 模仿放射科医生由粗到细的多级感知流程、将框定位与多轮点细化相结合的XFlow，能有效提升ILS的分割质量与可解释性，优于单次推理的ROSALIA。

Abstract: Existing text-guided segmentation models in the medical domain cover only a narrow set of anatomical structures and lesions in chest X-rays (CXRs), and most of them assume that the queried target is always present in the image. Instruction-guided lesion segmentation (ILS) was introduced to overcome these limitations by segmenting diverse lesion types from simple user instructions while also recognizing when the queried lesion is absent, and ROSALIA was proposed as the first model for this task. However, the masks produced by ROSALIA remain of limited quality, often carrying scattered noise. Moreover, ROSALIA predicts the mask in a single shot, which differs fundamentally from how radiologists perceive and delineate lesions in practice. A radiologist first surveys the entire thorax, then localizes the approximate region of abnormality, and only then refines the lesion contour. Motivated by this coarse-to-fine, multi-level perception process, we present XFlow, a workflow model for ILS that combines box-based localization with multi-turn point refinement. XFlow detects the lungs, decides whether the queried finding is present in each of them, and prompts a fine-tuned SAM with the lesion box for an initial mask. It then corrects that mask through point prompts until its boundary follows the lesion, leaving every intermediate decision visible. Our experiments show that XFlow achieves the best segmentation quality on both internal and external evaluation. Notably, it surpasses ROSALIA in segmentation quality even when the two are trained on the same lesion annotations. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [296] [Evidence Before Accuracy: A MRI-PET Fusion Network for Alzheimer Disease Classification with Causal Regional Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34520)
*Saeid Firouzi Daghigh,Saeed Ayat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究构建融合T1 MRI与FDG PET的深度学习模型用于AD分类（AUC 0.962），并通过捷径对照、标签置换、正向/反向ROI消融与归因分析，证明模型依赖AD相关神经生物学特征而非数据集伪影，形成"海马证据由MRI承载、后扣带证据由PET承载"的双重解离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD分类的深度学习模型常报告近乎完美的判别性能，但很少有工作证明其依据的是AD相关神经生物学，而非数据集伪影、受试者级泄漏或非脑图像内容。因此需要建立证据层来验证模型可解释性与生物学合理性。

Method: 在ADNI的554对配对受试者上训练融合T1 MRI与FDG PET的网络，覆盖轴位、冠状位、矢状位三个平面；先在验证集上搜索切片中心与邻层间距，量化模态、平面与切片几何的影响；再构建证据层：捷径对照（轮廓、外部、空白）、标签置换零假设、正向与反向ROI消融，以及多种归因方法的定量比较。

Result: 融合模型AUC 0.962、准确率0.909、F1 0.891，成本显著低于3D CNN与多模态Transformer。切片几何使MRI的AUC变动0.180、PET变动0.078，MRI偏好窄间距、PET偏好宽间距，所选冠状位中心分别落在海马体与后扣带。捷径对照使AUC降至0.622（轮廓）、0.608（外部）、0.500（空白），标签置换为0.456。正向ROI消融中，掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层与PET后部DMN对AD logit影响最大，面积匹配对照与零假设无异。反向消融显示MRI内侧颞叶单独保留89.2%、PET后部DMN单独保留79.0%的高于随机判别力。遮挡敏感性在先验AD区域内富集3.5–5.0倍，对照区仅0.10–0.43倍。

Conclusion: 消融与归因独立地确立了生物学正确的双重解离：海马证据由MRI承载，后扣带证据由PET承载。这表明该融合模型的判别性能建立在AD相关神经生物学之上，而非数据集伪影。

Abstract: Deep learning models for Alzheimer disease (AD) classification routinely report near-perfect discrimination, yet few are shown to rest on AD-relevant neurobiology rather than on dataset artifacts, subject-level leakage, or non-brain image content. We present a fusion network combining T1 MRI and FDG PET across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes, trained on ADNI consists of 554 paired subjects. The fusion model reaches AUC 0.962, accuracy 0.909, and F1 0.891, competitive with recent 3D CNN and multimodal transformer systems at substantially lower cost. We first quantify how much modality, plane and slice geometry matter. A validation-only search over slice centres and neighbour spacings moves AUC by 0.180 for MRI and 0.078 for PET, selecting narrow spacing for MRI and wide spacing for PET, with the chosen coronal centres falling on the hippocampal body and on the posterior cingulate respectively. The contribution, however, is the evidence layer built around that number. Shortcut controls collapse the model to AUC 0.622 (silhouette), 0.608 (exterior), and 0.500 (blank), and a label-permutation null yields 0.456. Forward region-of-interest (ROI) ablation shows that masking medial temporal cortex in MRI and the posterior default-mode network (DMN) in PET produces the largest shift in the AD logit, while area-matched controls remain indistinguishable from that null. Reverse ROI ablation shows that the medial temporal lobe alone retains 89.2% of above-chance discrimination in MRI and the posterior DMN alone retains 79.0% in PET. A quantitative comparison of attribution methods shows occlusion sensitivity reaching 3.5-5.0* enrichment inside a priori AD regions against 0.10-0.43* in controls. Ablation and attribution independently establish a biologically correct double dissociation: hippocampal evidence is carried by MRI, posterior cingulate evidence by PET.

</details>


### [297] [SAGE: Subspace Alignment for Classifier-Free Guidance in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34525)
*Boyu Zhang,Yangming Cheng,Ning Zhang,Pengfei Liu,Weijie Li,Yifan Gao,Hangyu Li,Litong Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散Transformer结合MoE路由时，CFG的两个分支独立路由导致激活子空间不一致，进而引发引导尺度放大残差并崩溃；提出训练期正则化方法SAGE，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，在零推理开销下显著缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer + MoE路由是扩展生成模型的主流方案，而CFG对生成质量至关重要，但过高引导尺度会引发崩溃。作者希望揭示二者组合中此前未被报告的失效模式：CFG两个分支独立路由，使各自实现激活落在不同子空间，无条件写入偏离条件子空间，且CFG会随引导尺度线性放大该残差。

Method: 提出SAGE——一种训练期正则化方法，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，同时不限制路由多样性，且不引入任何推理开销。

Result: 玩具实验显示SAGE将极端漂移抑制达9.2倍；扩展至10亿参数文本到图像模型时，峰值DPG-Bench性能提升9.3%；大量实验表明SAGE持续优于基线。

Conclusion: SAGE有效解决了扩散Transformer与MoE结合下CFG引发的子空间漂移与崩溃问题，在保持路由多样性和零推理成本的同时显著提升生成质量，具备良好的可扩展性与一致优势。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing are a leading recipe for scaling generative models. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for generation quality, yet excessively high guidance scales trigger collapse. We identify a previously unreported failure mode in their combination: the two CFG branches route independently, so their realized activations occupy different subspaces. The unconditional write then leaves the conditional subspace, and CFG amplifies that residual linearly in the guidance scale. We propose SAGE, a training-time regularizer that aligns unconditional MoE activations to the conditional subspace without restricting routing diversity, at zero inference cost. Toy experiments show that SAGE dramatically suppresses extreme drift by 9.2x.
