TL;DR: 提出 Balanced Fitting（BFQ），一种基于量化效应的训练后量化框架，平衡精度拟合与正则化收益，在多种 LVLM 的权重-only 与权重-激活量化下均优于现有 PTQ 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 的 PTQ 通常只用小校准集，却需泛化到多样下游任务。现有方法虽引入敏感性信号，但仍以对全精度模型的重建损失最小化为目标，可能过度保留 FP 行为与校准集特有偏置。作者观察到量化对某些层和模态也能提供有益正则化，因此不应仅把量化视为待最小化的误差。

Method: 提出 Balanced Fitting，基于"量化效应"的框架，超越纯重建式优化。分别度量权重、视觉激活、文本激活在层级与组件级的量化效应，对敏感组件进行细粒度拟合，对不敏感组件采用更粗粒度拟合以利用潜在正则化收益。

Result: 在多个 LVLM 上，方法在权重-only 与权重-激活量化设置下一致优于先前 PTQ 方法；同时发现更低的重建损失并不必然带来更好的下游性能。

Conclusion: 量化不仅是需最小化的误差，也可作为正则化手段；以量化效应为依据、平衡精细与粗糙拟合的 BFQ 能更可靠地提升 LVLM 下游表现。代码已开源。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large vision-language models (LVLMs), but is typically calibrated on a small set while expected to generalize across diverse downstream tasks. Although recent PTQ methods for LVLMs incorporate sensitivity signals, they still minimize reconstruction loss with respect to the full-precision model, potentially over-preserving FP behavior and calibration-specific bias. Rather than treating quantization solely as an error to be minimized, we observe that it can also provide beneficial regularization for certain layers and modalities. Motivated by this observation, we propose Balanced Fitting, a quantization effect-based framework that balances precision and regularization beyond reconstruction-based optimization. By measuring layer- and component-wise quantization effects for weights, vision activations, and text activations, Balanced Fitting combines fine-grained fitting for sensitive components with coarser fitting to exploit potential regularization benefits. Experiments on multiple LVLMs show that our method consistently outperforms prior PTQ approaches under both weight-only and weight-activation quantization, while lower reconstruction loss does not reliably translate into better downstream performance. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/BFQ

</details>


### [332] [When VLMs Trust Context: Evaluating Scene Text Recognition under Misleading Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34781)
*Yuxing Cheng,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SceneFaith基准（781张生成场景图像），研究VLM在场景文字与语境冲突时的"改写"行为，将输出分为Literal、Canonical、Other三类。15个模型全部出现改写，比例8.45%~58.51%；移除语境可降低改写，模糊目标文字则增加改写。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能读取自然场景中的文字，但其预测可能受周围语境影响：当印刷文字与场景暗示冲突时，模型可能返回更"合理"的词而非实际显示的文字。作者希望系统性地量化并剖析这一失败模式。

Method: 构建SceneFaith基准，包含781张生成的场景图像；将每个模型输出分类为Literal（忠实转录）、Canonical（与语境一致的改写）和Other（普通识别错误）。测试来自7个家族共15个模型，并开展受控实验：移除周围场景信息、替换同一文字块周围的场景、模糊目标文字。

Result: 所有15个模型在清晰图像上均出现改写，比率在8.45%~58.51%之间。移除周围场景信息后改写减少、字面准确率提升；改变同一文本块周围的场景也会改变模型输出；模糊目标文字会加剧改写。

Conclusion: 可靠的场景文字识别要求VLM在视觉字符证据与语境信息之间取得平衡：对清晰文字应保持忠实，仅在视觉证据不确定时才主要依赖语境。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can read text in natural scenes, but their predictions may be influenced by the surrounding context. When the printed text conflicts with what the scene suggests, a model may return a more plausible word instead of the shown text. We introduce SceneFaith, a benchmark of 781 generated scene images for studying this behavior. Each output is classified as Literal, Canonical, or Other, separating faithful transcription from context-consistent rewriting and ordinary recognition errors. Across 15 models from seven families, all models show rewriting on clear images, with rates ranging from 8.45\% to 58.51\%. Controlled experiments further show that surrounding context matters: removing surrounding scene information reduces rewriting and improves literal accuracy, while changing the scene around the same text patch can also change model outputs. Moreover, weakening the target text with blur increases rewriting. These results show that reliable scene-text recognition requires VLMs to balance visual character evidence with contextual information, preserving clear text while using context mainly when the visual evidence is uncertain.

</details>


### [333] [Projective Normal Fields: A Convex Optimization Method for Constructing Smooth UDFs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34784)
*Jiayi Kong,Chen Zong,Fei Hou,Junhui Hou,Wenping Wang,Ying He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Projective Normal Fields（PNF），一种无需法向定向的表示与凸优化框架，仅由点位置估计双向法向，并据此构建正则化 UDF 近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始点云既无表面连通性也无一致定向法向，直接学习标量 UDF 需处理零水平集不可微与远离样本处弱监督的问题，易导致优化不稳定与空间伪影。

Method: 用秩一投影算子编码每条法向轴，利用其对法向反转的不变性；将非凸硬投影集合松弛到其凸包——单位迹对称半正定矩阵。每个软张量定义局部二次距离模型并保留候选法向轴的相对权重。通过局部切平面拟合、软 PCA 锚定与固定邻域图上的重叠正则联合估计一致的 PNF；在正锚定权重下目标强凸且有唯一全局最优解。主特征向量给出双向法向，特征间隙给出谱置信度；据此选择并加权方向源进行热扩散，再用 Poisson 积分构造正则化 UDF 近似。

Result: 实验表明对邻域尺寸的敏感性降低，在噪声与离群点下重构具有竞争力，且在非流形交汇处精度提升。

Conclusion: 通过将局部几何估计与标量场构建分离，PNF 避免直接拟合不可微 UDF，为无定向点云提供稳定且鲁棒的 UDF 近似途径。

Abstract: Constructing a smooth approximation of an unsigned distance field (UDF) from a raw point cloud is challenging because the input provides neither surface connectivity nor consistently oriented normals. Methods that directly learn a scalar UDF must also handle its non-differentiability on the zero level set and weak supervision away from the samples, which can lead to unstable optimization and spatial artifacts. We introduce Projective Normal Fields (PNFs), an orientation-free representation and convex optimization framework for estimating bidirectional normals from point positions alone. Each normal axis is encoded by a rank-one projector, which is invariant to normal reversal. We relax the non-convex set of hard projectors to its convex hull: the symmetric positive-semidefinite matrices with unit trace. Each soft tensor defines a local quadratic distance model and retains the relative weights of candidate normal axes. We estimate a coherent PNF by combining local tangent-plane fitting, soft-PCA anchoring, and overlap regularization on a fixed neighborhood graph. With positive anchoring weights, the objective is strongly convex and admits a unique global minimizer. Principal eigenvectors provide bidirectional normals, while the corresponding eigengaps provide spectral confidence indicators. We use these indicators to select and weight directional sources for heat diffusion, followed by Poisson integration to construct a regularized UDF approximation. By separating local geometry estimation from scalar-field construction, PNF avoids directly fitting the non-differentiable UDF. Experiments demonstrate reduced sensitivity to neighborhood size, competitive reconstruction under noise and outliers, and improved accuracy near non-manifold junctions. The project page is available at https://anonymous17777367.github.io/PNF-page/

</details>


### [334] [D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34792)
*Zijian Ye,Chengqi Wei,Wei Huang,Anlin Zheng,Chunyu Zou,Liangyu Wu,Zikang Zhao,Zhenjie Peng,Yushuo Yang,Shuman Zhao,Zhongrui Wang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: D²-VLA 通过在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口上引入双记忆与双频率控制，使机器人能记住已离开视野的线索并响应移动物体，在长时程任务上显著超越 π₀.₅ 与 PUMA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程操作要求机器人在响应移动物体的同时记住已不在视野中的线索。然而现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常只依赖最新观测，刷新视觉上下文往往需要额外一次代价高昂的 VLM 前向推理，难以兼顾历史记忆与实时响应。

Method: 提出 D²-VLA，在预训练 VLA 的 KV-cache 接口上融合双记忆与双频率控制：采用分块因果 KV 缓存增量编码观测，并依据不同的时序注意力模式，为 VLM 与动作专家构建各自的历史 KV 读取视图；在周期性 VLM 更新之间，用门控适配器将新视觉特征注入最新的历史条件 KV 块，同时用短时快记忆队列支持动作重规划。

Result: 在十任务基准 DOMINO-Long 上，D²-VLA 在 DOMINO 取得 29.3% 的完整任务成功率，高于 π₀.₅ 的 9.6% 与 PUMA 的 17.2%；在 DOMINO-Long 上取得 60.0%，高于二者的 35.4% 与 20.6%。同时在八个真实机器人任务上提升成功率，并在 LIBERO-Long 达到 97.5%、RoboTwin 2.0 达到 74.3%。

Conclusion: 通过在 KV-cache 层面解耦历史读取与高频视觉更新，D²-VLA 有效缓解了 VLA 策略的记忆缺失与刷新开销问题，在长时程动态操作任务及多类基准与真实场景中均取得一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

</details>


### [335] [Physics-Guided Spectral Distillation for Underwater Image Enhancement on Resource-Constrained Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34795)
*Yifan Chen,Kai He,Ye Zheng,Jijun Lu,Zhe Sun,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出物理引导光谱蒸馏（PSD）方法，在保持水下图像增强性能的同时压缩模型容量以实现实时部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下图像增强研究主要关注增强质量和视觉保真度，很少考虑实时部署能力，而这对资源受限的水下机器人至关重要。

Method: PSD采用多级Haar离散小波变换分解教师与学生模型的输出，通过分频带目标迁移低频颜色与光照信息以及高频结构细节；蒸馏过程具备退化感知能力，通过物理头估计退化感知权重，并结合真值引导的可靠性掩码选择性保留有价值的教师指导。

Result: 在UIEB、LSUI和EUVP数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性；增强图像对下游感知任务（包括目标检测）有益；在自主研发的ROV上部署进一步证明了实际水下场景中的实用性。

Conclusion: PSD在降低模型容量的同时保持高性能，可实现资源受限平台的实时水下图像增强，并具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Underwater image enhancement is crucial for improving visual perception in marine applications. Existing underwater image enhancement studies mainly focus on enhancement quality and visual fidelity, while rarely considering real-time deployment capability, which is essential for resource-constrained underwater robots. To this end, we introduce a physics-guided spectral distillation (PSD) method, which reduces model capacity for real-time applications while maintaining the high performance of underwater image enhancement models. To decompose the outputs of teacher and student models, PSD adopts a multilevel Haar discrete wavelet transform. It transfers low-frequency color and illumination information as well as high-frequency structural details through band-specific objectives. Moreover, the distillation process of PSD is degradation-aware. We estimate degradation-aware weights through a physical head and combine them with ground-truth-guided reliability masks to selectively retain valuable teacher guidance. Experiments on the UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Furthermore, we demonstrate the benefits of enhanced images for downstream perception tasks, including object detection. Deployment on a self-developed ROV further demonstrates its practical applicability in real-world underwater scenarios.

</details>


### [336] [ControlTrace: Recovering Control Fields for Hidden-Content Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34807)
*Zijian Liu,Yaoguang Chen,Liwei Liu,Weixi Wu,Hanming Zhang,Jiashui Wang,Na Ruan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ControlTrace，通过恢复扩散生成时的灰度控制场，提升视觉语言模型对隐藏内容的识别能力，并构建FreqBlind基准进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间条件扩散模型能在自然图像中嵌入文字和轮廓，但视觉语言模型（VLM）往往无法识别这些隐藏内容。基于变换的恢复方法依赖参数与视角选择，效果受限。为系统评估隐藏内容的恢复与识别，需要构建基准并提出更有效的恢复方法。

Method: 构建FreqBlind基准：6,000张图像，涵盖轮廓、真实词与非词，跨越三种条件强度。提出ControlTrace：用8.4M参数的U-Net从载体图像预测生成时使用的灰度控制场，再交由VLM识别其内容。与三种基于变换的先前方法对比，并在四个VLM及JPEG压缩、高斯噪声、下采样条件下测试鲁棒性。

Result: ControlTrace配合Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct在三种条件强度下取得60.2%的开放式轮廓识别准确率，比三种先前方法中最佳者高出26.9个百分点。在A100 GPU上，完整流程仅比直接VLM推理增加7.4 ms（5.3%）。恢复场的像素误差更低、结构相似度更高。在四个VLM上整体轮廓识别优势保持，且在测试的JPEG压缩、高斯噪声与下采样下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 在评估设定下，控制场恢复方法能有效支持隐藏内容的识别，优于基于变换的恢复方法，且鲁棒、开销小。

Abstract: Spatially conditioned diffusion models can embed words and contours in natural-looking images, but vision-language models (VLMs) may fail to recognize the hidden content. Transformation-based recovery depends on parameter and view selection. To evaluate hidden-content recovery and recognition, we construct FreqBlind, a 6,000-image benchmark spanning contours, real words and non-words across three conditioning strengths. The evaluated transformation-based methods show limited recognition of contour patterns and weakly conditioned hidden content. To address this limitation, we propose ControlTrace to recover the grayscale control field used during generation. An 8.4M-parameter U-Net predicts this field from the carrier image, and a VLM then identifies its content. With Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, ControlTrace achieves 60.2% open-ended contour recognition accuracy across the three conditioning strengths, exceeding the best of the three evaluated prior methods by 26.9 percentage points. On an A100 GPU, the complete pipeline adds only 7.4 ms (5.3%) to direct VLM inference. Recovered fields have lower pixel errors and higher structural similarity than the evaluated transformation views. Across four evaluated VLMs, ControlTrace retains its overall contour recognition advantage. Recognition remains stable under the tested JPEG compression, Gaussian noise and downsampling. These results support control-field recovery for hidden-content recognition in the evaluated setting.

</details>


### [337] [From Perception to Integration: Revisiting the Internal Dynamics of Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34809)
*Rong Yu Xu,Prayag Tiwari,Shaolei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在需要多项视觉判断的复合任务上的短板，通过反事实图像对与状态干预揭示各单项判断无需显式推理即可完成，并发现复合答案在推理过程中会提前变得可解码。作者训练小型检测器预测这一"就绪"时刻并提前停止推理，在MMStar和RealWorldQA上分别减少79.1%和74.5%的推理token，准确率还分别提升3.13和3.30个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM能回答简单视觉问题，但在单问题需要多项视觉判断时表现不佳。论文希望探究这一差距的来源，并找到更高效的推理计算分配方式。

Method: 设计受控任务：特征绑定、数量、空间关系、非模态补全，以及将它们组合的复合任务；使用匹配的反事实图像对隔离所需视觉证据的变化。对四个模型进行直接回答、隐状态读出与状态干预分析。随后训练一个小型检测器预测模型何时"准备好"答案，并据此提前停止推理。

Result: 单项判断无需显式推理即可完成，干预对应状态可影响答案；复合答案在推理过程中可从隐状态解码，且常能从缩短的推理链中得到，往往早于模型自行停止。在MMStar和RealWorldQA上，平均推理token分别减少79.1%和74.5%，平均准确率分别提升3.13和3.30个百分点。

Conclusion: 该研究将答案就绪性的内部发展与一条实用的推理算力分配规则联系起来，表明可以更早终止推理而同时提升准确率与效率。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer simple visual questions, but often struggle when one question requires several visual judgments. We study this gap with controlled tasks for feature binding, numerosity, spatial relations, and amodal completion, together with a Composite task that combines them. Matched counterfactual image pairs isolate changes in the visual evidence needed to answer. Across four models, direct answers, hidden-state readouts, and state interventions show that the individual judgments can be made without explicit reasoning and that intervening on the corresponding states can affect the answer. During reasoning, the Composite answer becomes decodable from hidden states and usable from shortened traces, often before the model stops on its own. We train a small detector to predict this readiness and stop reasoning at that point. On MMStar and RealWorldQA, this reduces mean reasoning tokens by 79.1% and 74.5%, while average accuracy rises by 3.13 and 3.30 percentage points, respectively. These findings connect the internal development of answer readiness to a practical rule for allocating reasoning computation.

</details>


### [338] [ESTHER: Egocentric Stereo Hand Estimation and Reconstruction in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34817)
*Hongyu Ma,Hairong Qu,Shiqi Zhao,Yongsong Yang,Peng Yin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ESTHER——面向可穿戴自中心立体视觉的端到端度量3D手部重建模型，并构建配套基准ESTHER3D（含大规模野外伪标签训练集与动捕真值测试集）。实验取得SOTA精度、更强的跨域泛化，且在缺视图、丢帧、极端光照与运动模糊下保持鲁棒；其立体引导使模型能将表观手部尺度绑定到度量深度，仅需极少微调即可适配不同立体设备与模态，甚至降级为单目视图后仍保留真实度量尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自中心立体视觉是人类双手精细操作所依赖的自然感知接口，对机器人、AR、VR同样如此；然而从该信号出发的度量3D手部重建既缺少端到端模型，也缺少真实野外场景下的基准。

Method: ESTHER的立体几何、时序推理与输出表征均针对可穿戴自中心立体输入设计；训练使用来自标定标注流程的伪标签，并据此汇编基准ESTHER3D——将模型生成标签的大规模野外训练集与动捕真值测试集配对。

Result: 实验显示SOTA精度、优越的外部泛化能力，以及对真实自中心采集中的缺失视图、丢帧、极端光照和运动模糊的鲁棒性；立体引导使表观手部尺度与度量深度绑定，可在极少微调下适配不同立体设备与模态，并在退化为单目视图后仍保持真实度量尺度。

Conclusion: 自中心立体是手部度量重建的自然接口，ESTHER与ESTHER3D填补了端到端模型与野外基准的空白；立体监督带来的度量尺度绑定显著提升鲁棒性与泛化，甚至使单目退化情形也具备真实尺度。

Abstract: Human dexterity is guided by two eyes watching two hands: binocular vision supplies the metric 3D structure that fine-grained manipulation consumes. Egocentric stereo is therefore the natural perceptual interface for robots, AR, and VR-yet metric 3D hand reconstruction from this very signal still has neither an end-to-end model nor an in-the-wild benchmark. We propose ESTHER, a model whose stereo geometry, temporal reasoning, and output representation are designed for wearable egocentric stereo. It is trained on pseudo-labels from a calibrated labeling pipeline and in turn assembles our benchmark ESTHER3D, an egocentric stereo hand dataset pairing a large in-the-wild training set of model-generated labels with a motion capture test set of true metric ground truth. Experiments show state-of-the-art accu?racy, superior external generalization, and robustness to the missing views, dropped frames, and lighting and motion blur extremes of real egocentric capture that break existing meth?ods. This robustness runs deeper than graceful degradation: stereo guidance teaches the model to bind apparent hand scale to metric depth, so it not only adapts to different stereo rigs and modalities with minimal fine-tuning, but more strikingly preserves true metric scale even after collapsing to a single monocular view.

</details>


### [339] [Generative Residual Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34824)
*Letian Gong,Yuzhou Hong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在共享因子模型下，将图像块的条件熵分解为不可约的残差熵与可通过更优历史表示消除的后验项，并指出下一嵌入预测的浅层映射存在不可辨识纤维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厘清"下一嵌入预测"类目标中，哪些不确定性本质上不可消除，哪些可通过更好的历史表示来消除，从而为表示学习目标的设计提供理论依据。

Method: 在共享因子模型下，将下一图像块的条件分布分解为共享场景因子上的后验与给定该因子的残差核；用历史的充分统计量替代原始历史；对条件熵作分解；在标量高斯模型中给出闭式解并验证该分解为等式。

Result: 条件熵分解为残差熵（观测因子亦无法消除）与后验项（可由更好的历史表示消除）；下一嵌入预测是浅层映射上的方向似然，该映射的纤维不可辨识，常数嵌入仍是极小值点；标量高斯模型下该分解取等号且可闭式求解。

Conclusion: 熵的分解为区分"表示瓶颈"与"内在随机性"提供了判据；浅层映射的纤维不可辨识意味着下一嵌入预测目标本身不足以约束嵌入，常数解是其退化解。

Abstract: Under a shared-factor model, the conditional law of the next image patch factors into a posterior over the shared scene factor and a residual kernel given that factor. A sufficient statistic of the past replaces the raw past in the posterior and does not replace the kernel. The conditional entropy splits into residual entropy, which no observation of the factor can remove, and a posterior term, which a better representation of the past can remove. Next-embedding prediction is a directional likelihood on a shallow map, so the fiber of that map is unidentified and a constant embedding remains a minimizer. The same split is an equality in a scalar Gaussian model, evaluated in closed form.

</details>


### [340] [WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34826)
*Yuheng Zha,Yilei Wang,Qiyue Gao,Junrong Chen,Yujia Wu,Zhengfeng Lai,Zhengzhong Liu,Eric P. Xing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 WM-VLM，为预训练视觉语言模型加装轻量级世界模型分支以生成中间视觉状态，并采用两阶段训练（先生成下一视觉状态、再基于该状态推理）。在可验证中间视觉状态的2D/3D心理旋转任务上，WM-VLM 相比监督微调基线最高提升39.25个百分点，消融实验表明增益依赖生成的视觉状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类常通过心理模拟视觉变换来解决空间问题，而主流视觉语言模型（VLM）主要依赖语言进行推理。作者希望探究 VLM 能否结合文本与生成的视觉状态进行空间推理。

Method: 提出 WM-VLM：在预训练 VLM 上附加轻量级世界模型分支以生成中间视觉状态。采用两阶段训练：第一阶段学习生成下一视觉状态，第二阶段学习利用该状态进行推理。同时以程序化方式构建带可验证中间视觉状态的空间推理任务，用于评估视觉状态生成质量及其被依赖程度。

Result: 在2D与3D心理旋转任务上，WM-VLM 稳定优于监督微调的主干模型，最高提升39.25个百分点。消融实验显示，移除或破坏生成的视觉状态会显著降低性能，说明增益依赖于这些视觉状态。

Conclusion: 内部世界模型为 VLM 同时在语言与视觉空间中推理提供了一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.

</details>


### [341] [Multi-Scale Semantic Mapping in Urban Environments via Observation Calibration and Policy Dependence Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34833)
*Runling Long,Junhao Feng,Jia Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对城市环境语义建图中存在的“尺度—观测距离失配”与“异质建图策略”两大难题，本文构建了大规模城市语义建图数据集，并提出类别感知似然校准策略、互信息正则化与类别级价值估计器，并将联合优化建模为帕累托优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义建图方法主要面向室内环境，其物体尺度变化有限、观测视角受限；而城市环境中物体尺度跨度大（行人到建筑）、导航空间大、观测距离差异显著，导致现有数据集与方法难以覆盖。具体表现为两点困难：一是物体尺度与观测距离可能严重失配（小物体远距观测、大物体极近观测），导致观测似然不可靠；二是尺寸与几何差异巨大的物体需要不同的建图行为，单一共享价值估计器难以刻画。

Method: 1) 构建大规模城市语义建图数据集：真实城市布局、高保真渲染、实例级标注并覆盖多物体尺度；2) 提出类别感知的似然校准策略，依据物体类别与观测距离识别并缓解不可靠观测；3) 引入互信息（MI）正则项，惩罚校准策略与运动策略的表示依赖，鼓励二者行为互补，避免因优化同一建图目标而学到冗余捷径、过度耦合；4) 采用类别级价值估计器以建模跨尺度的异质建图策略，并将其联合优化表述为帕累托优化问题以缓解类别间梯度冲突。

Result: 论文引入了一个覆盖多物体尺度、具备真实城市布局与高保真渲染及实例级标注的大规模城市语义建图数据集，用于研究上述挑战；并通过类别感知似然校准、MI 正则化与类别级价值估计器及帕累托式联合优化，针对不可靠观测、策略耦合与跨类别梯度冲突问题给出了对应解决方案。

Conclusion: 城市语义建图在尺度与观测距离高度多样化的条件下，需要类别感知的观测校准、互补的策略学习以及按类别区分的价值估计；通过互信息正则化解耦校准与运动策略、以帕累托优化协调多类别梯度，可更有效地应对城市环境的异质建图需求。

Abstract: Semantic mapping is fundamental to embodied navigation, yet existing methods are developed for indoor environments, where objects exhibit relatively limited scale variation and are observed from a restricted range of viewpoints. Urban environments pose substantially greater challenges: agents must map objects ranging from pedestrians to buildings while navigating large spaces with highly diverse viewing distances. These conditions introduce two key difficulties that existing datasets and methods fail to cover. First, object scale and observation distance can be severely mismatched. For example, small objects may be viewed from far away, whereas large objects may be observed at extremely close range, resulting in unreliable observation likelihoods. Second, objects with substantially different sizes and geometries require distinct mapping behaviors, which are difficult to capture with a single shared value estimator. To investigate these challenges, we introduce a large-scale urban semantic mapping dataset featuring realistic city layouts, high-fidelity rendering, and instance-level annotations spanning multiple object scales. We then propose a category-aware likelihood calibration policy that identifies and alleviates unreliable observations according to object category and viewing distance. Because the calibration and motion policies are optimized toward the same mapping objective, they may learn redundant shortcuts and become excessively coupled. We therefore introduce a mutual-information (MI) regularizer that penalizes their estimated representation dependence and encourages complementary behaviors. To better model heterogeneous mapping strategies across object scales, we further employ category-wise value estimators. We formulate their joint optimization as a Pareto optimization problem to mitigate conflicting gradients across categories.

</details>


### [342] [Transform-Aligned Learned Features for Lossy Point Cloud Attribute Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34834)
*Yueru Chen,Pengpeng Yu,Dingquan Li,Wei Gao,Wei Zhang,Fei Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TALF，将属性变换作用于学习到的空间表示，使其与编码目标显式对齐，并集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，提升点云属性压缩的率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于变换的方法通过将属性表示为变换系数实现点云属性压缩，但将学习到的空间上下文引入该框架时，需要一个从空间表示到变换域的映射（已知的基变换），而现有方法往往让网络隐式学习这一映射，缺乏显式对齐。

Method: 提出Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF)：将属性变换直接应用于学习到的空间表示，显式对齐编码目标；理论分析表明所得特征恰好表示平滑非线性模型的一阶预测项，且泰勒余项有界。将TALF集成到基于变换的属性编解码器中，采用显式系数预测与条件残差熵建模，在统一的系数域率失真目标下优化，同时保留显式量化步长控制。

Result: 在三个基准数据集和多种变换基上进行了大量实验，TALF相较传统方法与学习型基线均提升了率失真性能。

Conclusion: 将已知基变换显式作用于学习特征并与编码目标对齐，是提升基于变换的点云属性压缩的有效途径，且具备理论解释。

Abstract: Transform-based methods provide an effective framework for point cloud attribute compression by representing attributes as transform coefficients. Introducing learned spatial context into this framework requires mapping spatial representations to the transform domain, but this known basis change is often left for the network to learn implicitly. We propose Transform-Aligned Learned Features (TALF) by applying the attribute transform to learned spatial representations, explicitly aligning them with the coding targets. Our analysis shows that the resulting features exactly represent the first-order prediction term of a smooth nonlinear model, with a bounded Taylor remainder. We integrate TALF into a transform-based attribute codec with explicit coefficient prediction and conditional residual entropy modeling under a unified coefficient-domain rate--distortion objective, while retaining explicit quantization-step control. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets and multiple transform bases demonstrate that TALF improves rate--distortion performance over conventional and learned baselines.

</details>


### [343] [ORAV: Benchmarking Audio-Video Generation from Multimodal Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34843)
*Jiacheng Hua,Xiaokun Feng,Jiaqi Hua,Chang Liu,Biao Wang,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ORAV Bench，一个面向全参考音视频生成（Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation）的基准，包含 380 个任务实例、2–10 个参考、9 种语义角色与 30 种角色组合，并配套参考感知的成对评估协议（与人类判断有效一致率 86.08%），用于衡量多模态参考下的可控、组合式、忠于参考的音视频生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用异构多模态参考进行音视频生成是新出现的挑战，既要求对生成结果进行组合式控制，又要求对多模态上下文有扎实的理解。然而现有评测缺少能够覆盖多参考、多角色组合并考察参考忠实度的基准与评估方法，因此亟需一个系统性基准来追踪该任务的进展。

Method: 构建 ORAV Bench：380 个任务实例，每个含 2–10 个参考、9 种语义角色、30 种角色组合；指令规定参考之间的关系，媒体提供需实现的身份、动态与音频特征。评估上提出参考感知的成对（pairwise）协议：准备视觉与听觉证据，比较每个参考的预期贡献，并在两种呈现顺序下核验总体判定。此外提供可复现的逐点（pointwise）诊断，覆盖质量、参考亲和度与语音等维度。

Result: 该成对评估协议在留出实例上与人类判断达到 86.08% 的有效一致率。在 5 个前沿系统上，总体排名掩盖了不同参考组合下各自不同的优势；一个反复出现的失败模式是复现了非预期的源内容而非所请求的结果，尽管其与某个参考高度相似。逐点诊断揭示了模型行为的不同维度。

Conclusion: ORAV 为追踪可控、组合式且忠于参考的音视频生成进展提供了基准，其参考感知成对协议与逐点诊断能够揭示单一总体排名所无法体现的模型行为差异与失败模式。

Abstract: Audio-video generation using heterogeneous multimodal references has emerged as a new challenge, requiring both compositional control over generation and grounded understanding of multimodal context. In this paper, we introduce ORAV Bench for Omni Reference Audio-Video Generation, comprising 380 task instances with 2-10 references, 9 semantic roles, and 30 role compositions. Instructions specify the relationships among references; the media supply the identities, dynamics, and audio characteristics to be realized. To evaluate these open-ended outputs, we develop a reference-aware pairwise protocol that prepares visual and auditory evidence, compares the intended contribution of each reference, and checks the overall verdict in both presentation orders. On held-out instances, it achieves 86.08% effective agreement with human judgments. Across 5 frontier systems, overall rankings conceal distinct strengths across reference compositions. A recurring failure is to reproduce unintended source content in place of the requested result, despite closely resembling a reference. Reproducible pointwise diagnostics of quality, reference affinity, and speech reveal distinct dimensions of model behavior. ORAV thus offers a benchmark for tracking progress toward controllable, compositional, and reference-faithful audio-video generation.

</details>


### [344] [EviSplat: Preserving Multi-View Evidence in 3D Gaussian Splatting for Open-Vocabulary Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34853)
*Sungho Moon,Kota Shimomura,Junwoo Park,Wonhyeok Choi,Seunghun Lee,Takayoshi Yamashita,Sunghoon Im*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 EviSplat，将多视角观测特征作为证据保留至查询时，并依查询动态聚合，实现开放词汇 3D 场景理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的开放词汇方法在查询前就把多视角观测（如单视图掩码裁剪）压缩为语言特征或紧凑物体描述子。但同一物体的不同视角观测信息量不等，有的提供与特定查询相关的线索，有的不完整甚至误导。预查询阶段的整合会抑制后续查询所依赖的线索，导致信息丢失。

Method: EviSplat 保留个体观测特征，并将其存放在类无关的 3D 实例中，实例可表示物体、物体部件或背景区域。为每个 Gaussian 学习一个分布，描述其观测所支持的视觉外观。给定文本查询时，先用实例中最相关的观测对实例打分，再将实例级相关性与局部支持的证据结合，按该 Gaussian 被观测的频次与 unambiguous 程度加权，为每个 Gaussian 计算得分，使不同查询可从同一保留证据中调用不同的视觉线索。

Result: 在多种数据集和评测协议上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，验证了将多视角证据保留至查询时并按查询聚合的有效性。

Conclusion: 保留多视角证据至查询时、并按查询动态聚合，是提升开放词汇 3D 场景理解的有效范式，优于查询前的固定整合策略。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding enables object localization and segmentation from free-form text queries without a fixed category vocabulary. Many recent methods build on 3D Gaussian Splatting and consolidate multi-view observations, such as masked crops from individual views, into language features or compact object descriptors before the query is known. However, observations of the same object vary across viewpoints and are not equally informative: some reveal cues relevant to a particular query, whereas others provide incomplete or misleading evidence. Pre-query consolidation can therefore suppress cues on which a later query depends. We introduce EviSplat, which preserves individual observation features as evidence for later text queries. EviSplat retains individual observation features within class-agnostic 3D instances that represent objects, object parts, or background regions. It also learns, for each Gaussian, a distribution describing which visual appearances its observations support. Given a text query, EviSplat scores each instance using its most relevant observations. It then computes a score for each Gaussian by combining instance-level relevance with locally supported evidence, weighted by how often and how unambiguously that Gaussian was observed. Different queries can thus draw on different visual cues from the same preserved evidence. Experiments across diverse datasets and evaluation protocols demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, supporting the benefit of preserving multi-view evidence until query time and aggregating it according to the query.

</details>


### [345] [When Text Matters: Design Principles for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34861)
*Minchan Kang,Kyeonghye Park,Seoyoung Cho,Daeshik Kim,Yucheol Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的两阶段视觉token剪枝方法DeFT：先用视觉编码器注意力进行早期剪枝，延迟到解码器中间层再用文本到视觉注意力完成最终重选，在八个基准、三个模型上显著提升性能恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型计算开销大，视觉token剪枝是常用的降本手段，但现有方法难以保留关键视觉信息：基于图像的token选择会忽略任务相关细节，而文本引导的token选择又难以捕捉复杂推理所需的文本-视觉关系。作者发现，过早施加文本引导会限制其识别与答案相关视觉区域的能力，而文本到视觉注意力在解码器中间层才更具信息量。

Method: 提出无需训练的DeFT方法，将早期视觉引导剪枝与延后的文本引导重选分离：首先利用视觉编码器注意力对视觉token进行剪枝，并额外保留部分候选token直至解码器中点，随后用文本到视觉注意力确定最终的视觉token集合。

Result: 在八个基准和三个模型上，该方法在80%和90%剪枝率下的性能恢复分别平均超过最佳基线11.10和16.84个百分点，且LLM预填充延迟与大多数基线相当或更低。源代码已公开。

Conclusion: 通过在解码器中间层延迟引入文本引导，能够更有效识别答案相关的视觉区域，从而在保持较低预填充延迟的同时大幅缓解剪枝带来的性能损失，验证了视觉引导与文本引导分阶段、分时机使用的有效性。

Abstract: Visual token pruning has been widely studied as a practical approach to reducing the computational cost of large vision-language models. However, it struggles to preserve essential visual information, which can lead to substantial performance degradation. In particular, image-based token selection can overlook task-relevant details, while text-guided token selection may fail to capture the text--visual relationships needed for complex reasoning. We find that applying textual guidance too early can limit its ability to identify answer-relevant visual regions, whereas text-to-visual attention becomes more informative at intermediate decoder depths. This finding motivates our training-free method, which separates early vision-guided pruning from deferred text-guided reselection. We first prune visual tokens using vision-encoder attention, retain additional candidates until the decoder midpoint, and then use text-to-visual attention to determine the final visual-token set. Across eight benchmarks and three models, our method outperforms the best-performing baselines by an average of 11.10 and 16.84 percentage points in performance recovery at 80% and 90% pruning, respectively, with comparable or lower LLM-prefill latency than most baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/DeFT

</details>


### [346] [Revisit to Segment: Working Memory Distillation for Reasoning Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34863)
*Cilin Yan,Yilun Qiu,Wanyang Zhang,Rui Zu,Xiaolong Jiang,Yao Hu,Jiayin Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 SWiM，一种面向推理分割的工作记忆蒸馏框架：利用模型自身生成的推理轨迹与定位提议作为上下文来增强推理分割，并通过在工作记忆条件下的教师模型向仅接收图像与查询的学生模型进行token级蒸馏，结合策略内自蒸馏与结果强化学习联合优化，取得SOTA效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型在推理分割中生成的回答包含推理轨迹与定位提议，可作为重访同一图像与查询时的工作记忆，实验发现这种自生成的工作记忆能提升推理分割表现。作者希望将这种由重访先验尝试获得的指导内化到骨干模型中，使其在推理时无论是否有工作记忆都能受益。

Method: 提出 SWiM（Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory）工作记忆蒸馏框架：1）根据分割质量筛选rollout以构建工作记忆；2）以工作记忆条件下的模型作为教师，在学生生成的轨迹上提供token级分布监督；3）学生仅接收原始图像与查询；4）通过策略内自蒸馏与基于结果（outcome-based）的强化学习联合优化，将工作记忆指导与分割质量反馈结合。

Result: 在多个推理分割基准上，SWiM 达到SOTA性能，验证了工作记忆蒸馏的有效性。

Conclusion: 将自生成的工作记忆通过蒸馏内化到推理分割模型中是一种有效策略，SWiM 通过教师-学生蒸馏加结果强化学习的联合训练，使模型在推理时无需工作记忆也能获得增强的推理分割能力。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have approached image segmentation by reasoning about visual content and predicting target locations. Their generated responses contain reasoning traces and localization proposals that can serve as working memory when revisiting the same image and query. Our exploration reveals that MLLMs benefit from using this self-generated working memory as context, leading to enhanced reasoning segmentation. Motivated by this finding, we seek to strengthen the backbone model's reasoning segmentation capabilities by distilling the guidance gained from revisiting prior attempts, enabling it to benefit with or without working memory at inference time. To this end, we propose Reasoning Segmenter with Working Memory (SWiM), a working-memory distillation framework for reasoning segmentation. Specifically, SWiM selects rollouts based on segmentation quality to construct working memory and uses the memory-conditioned model as a teacher. The teacher provides token-level distributional supervision along student-generated trajectories, while the student receives only the original image and query. Joint optimization of on-policy self-distillation and outcome-based reinforcement learning combines working-memory guidance with direct feedback on segmentation quality. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that SWiM achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of working-memory distillation.

</details>


### [347] [P4Q: Co-designing Token Pruning and Quantization for Vision-Language Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34867)
*Haizhao Jing,Zhenhao Shang,Haokui Zhang,Rong Xiao,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 P4Q，一个联合优化视觉 token 剪枝与低比特量化的协同设计框架，用于高效 VLM 推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型性能强但计算与内存开销大，视觉 token 剪枝和训练后量化分别从序列长度和数值精度两个维度降低推理开销。然而现有流程通常独立优化或顺序叠加这两项技术，二者优化目标不同，关键交互未被处理，限制了可达到的压缩性能。

Method: P4Q 包含两个耦合组件：一是在 LLM 之前引入量化感知的视觉 token 选择策略，对 projector 输出特征的副本施加伪量化，并基于伪量化特征计算的统计量来选择视觉 token，使选择器的基于特征的决策受模拟低比特扰动影响；二是剪枝感知的量化校准策略，使用与剪枝相同的选择策略，在保留 token 的分布上校准量化模型，使校准过程与部署时的剪枝执行路径对齐。

Result: 在 LLaVA-NeXT 上，P4Q 在八个不同测试集上实现平均 2.8 倍的端到端推理加速，同时保持高于先前压缩与量化方法的准确率。

Conclusion: 通过将视觉 token 剪枝与低比特量化协同耦合，P4Q 在保持相当任务性能的同时实现显著推理加速，获得优于独立优化流程的效率-精度权衡。

Abstract: Vision language models have achieved strong performance across a wide range of multimodal applications, yet their substantial computational and memory costs hinder efficient deployment. Visual token pruning and post-training quantization reduce inference overhead along two complementary dimensions, namely sequence length and numerical precision. Existing workflows typically optimize these techniques independently or apply them sequentially. Their distinct optimization objectives leave critical interactions unaddressed and constrain the achievable compression performance. We revisit these designs and present P4Q, a practical co-design framework that jointly optimizes visual token pruning and low-bit quantization for efficient VLM inference. First, P4Q introduces a quantization-aware visual token selection strategy before the LLM. It applies fake quantization to copies of the features produced by the projector and selects visual tokens using statistics computed from these fake-quantized features, thereby conditioning the selector's feature-based decisions on simulated low-bit perturbations. Second, P4Q introduces a pruning-aware quantization calibration strategy. It uses the same selection strategy as pruning to calibrate the quantized model on the retained-token distribution, thereby aligning the calibration process with the pruned execution path used during deployment. By coupling these two components, P4Q achieves substantial inference speedups while maintaining comparable task performance, resulting in a better efficiency-accuracy trade-off than independently optimized pipelines. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT, P4Q achieves an average end-to-end inference speedup of 2.8x across eight distinct test sets, while retaining higher accuracy than prior compression and quantization methods.

</details>


### [348] [SPOC-Net: Single-Primitive Online Composition Network for GNSS Jamming Set Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34875)
*Zhihan Zeng,Kaihe Wang,José A. López-Salcedo,Gonzalo Seco-Granados,Zhongpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SPOC-Net，将GNSS干扰识别重构为基本干扰组件集合的识别问题，用实测单组件IQ按需合成训练混合样本，在14220个实测射频混合样本上取得80.69%精确集合准确率与92.84%微平均F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠的定位、导航与授时（PNT）支撑智能交通、自主系统与空天地一体化网络，但GNSS干扰识别面临可扩展性瓶颈：将每种混合视为独立类别的识别器难以泛化到训练中未出现的新组合。因此需要一种可组合、可外推的识别框架。

Method: SPOC-Net将识别问题分解为若干基本干扰组件的判定。利用多分辨率时频特征与可学习的组件查询为每类组件提供证据；由高分辨率分支估计活跃组件类型数量，再用结构化解码器将数量估计与组件证据结合，输出有效组件集合。训练上，仅以实测单组件记录作为梯度优化中的物理样本，其干净IQ序列在训练中按需组合，生成具有不同相对功率与干噪比的带标签混合样本；另用10种训练清单内组合的实测混合样本进行模型选择与解码器标定，剩余6种组合留作最终测试。

Result: 在14220个独立生成、传导合成并录制的射频混合样本上，取得80.69%的精确集合准确率与92.84%的微平均F1。在未参与模型开发的组合上，SPOC-Net精确集合准确率为80.89%，在所述协议下超过最强对比方法18.77个百分点。

Conclusion: 实验表明，将混合识别分解为基本组件集合判定可显著提升对未见组合的泛化能力，SPOC-Net在组合外推场景下优于现有方法，验证了基于单组件实测数据合成训练样本这一策略的有效性。

Abstract: Reliable positioning, navigation, and timing support intelligent transportation, autonomous systems, and space-air-ground integrated networks. However, global navigation satellite system (GNSS) jamming recognizers that treat each mixture as a separate class are difficult to extend to new combinations. Therefore, this paper proposes SPOC-Net, which decomposes the recognition problem into identifying a set of basic jamming components. Multi-resolution time-frequency features and learned component queries provide evidence for each component type. A high-resolution branch estimates the number of active types, and a structured decoder combines this estimate with component evidence to select a valid set. For training, measured single-component records are the only physical samples used in gradient optimization. Their associated clean in-phase and quadrature (IQ) sequences are combined on demand during training to produce labeled mixtures with different relative powers and jamming-to-noise ratios. Separate measured mixtures from ten training-listed compositions support model selection and decoder calibration; six other compositions are reserved for final testing. Evaluation on 14,220 independently generated, conductively combined, and recorded radio frequency mixtures yields 80.69% exact-set accuracy and a 92.84% micro-averaged F1 score. On combinations excluded from model development, SPOC-Net achieves 80.89% exact-set accuracy, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 18.77 percentage points under the reported protocols.

</details>


### [349] [SubRot: Signed Gradient Subspace Calibration for VLM Rotation Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34884)
*Zhenhao Shang,Haizhao Jing,Haokui Zhang,Guoting Wei,Rong Xiao,Jianqing Gao,Peng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SubRot，一种针对视觉语言模型旋转量化的带符号梯度子空间校准方法，在低比特下更好保持多模态能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 训练后量化依赖模态级或 token 级梯度统计，易受跨样本视觉-文本 token 比例及视觉信息位置变化影响，统计不稳定；且绝对值和平均的粗粒度聚合丢弃梯度符号与通道差异，难以分离模态敏感度。通道空间提供跨样本共享坐标系，是捕捉稳定任务敏感结构的更自然基础。

Method: SubRot 对激活梯度的经验 Fisher 矩阵做特征分解，识别具有跨样本稳定性、敏感度清晰分离、以及沿某些方向对自回归损失有一致带符号效应的敏感通道子空间。基于局部 Taylor 展开，沿符号稳定方向施加带符号一阶引导，在其余敏感方向施加二阶约束，同时保留 MSE 以维持整体重建质量，从而将量化误差导向降低损失的方向并控制其幅度。

Result: 在 5 个 VLM、5 个基准上，W4A6 和 W4A4 下平均分持续优于 FlatQuant，LLaVA-NeXT-7B 提升达 1.4 个百分点。W4A4 下所有评估模型相对 FP16 平均精度下降不超过 1.4 个百分点，LLaVA-v1.5-13B 甚至超过其 FP16 平均分 0.4 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过带符号梯度子空间校准，SubRot 在低比特 VLM 旋转量化中稳定提升多模态性能，验证了通道空间敏感子空间建模的有效性。

Abstract: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of vision-language models (VLMs), but preserving multimodal capabilities at low bit widths remains challenging. Existing methods rely on modality- or token-level gradient statistics, which are susceptible to cross-sample variations in visual-to-textual token ratios and the positions of visual information, limiting statistical stability. Moreover, overly coarse aggregation through absolute values and averaging discards gradient signs and channel-wise differences, limiting the separation of modality-specific sensitivities. In contrast, the channel space provides a shared coordinate system across samples, making it a more natural basis for capturing stable task-sensitive structures. We therefore propose SubRot, a signed gradient subspace calibration method for VLM rotation quantization. Through eigendecomposition of the empirical Fisher matrix of activation gradients, SubRot identifies a sensitive channel subspace with three properties: cross-sample stability, clear sensitivity separation, and consistent signed effects on the autoregressive loss along certain directions. Guided by a local Taylor expansion, SubRot combines signed first-order guidance along sign-stable directions with second-order constraints along the remaining sensitive directions, while retaining MSE for overall reconstruction quality. This objective steers quantization errors toward loss-decreasing directions while controlling their magnitude. Experiments on five VLMs across five benchmarks show consistent average-score improvements over FlatQuant under W4A6 and W4A4, reaching 1.4 percentage points on LLaVA-NeXT-7B. Under W4A4, average accuracy degradation from FP16 remains within 1.4 percentage points across all evaluated models, while LLaVA-v1.5-13B exceeds its FP16 average score by 0.4 percentage points.

</details>


### [350] [ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34893)
*Xinyue Wang,Yicheng Jiang,Zesen Gan,Junhao He,Jiaxu Wang,Junhao Li,Jingtao Zhang,Tianlun He,Jianan Wang,Isabel Guan,Qiming Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ECHO：一种仅用腕部事件相机的潜在世界动作模型，通过"事后"与"展望"模块提供时空上下文，显著提升极端曝光下的操作策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于RGB相机的操作策略在极端曝光下观测质量严重下降；事件相机虽具高动态范围，但受相机布置限制：固定相机漏掉静态场景内容，腕部相机运动又使已访问区域脱离视野，存在时空局限。

Method: 提出ECHO（Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook），仅用腕部事件相机，将事件流编码为紧凑运动表征。使用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化；hindsight模块以过去事件流保存夹爪轨迹作为可寻址的离视野上下文；outlook模块引入可学习的事件前瞻查询，经监督预测未来动作的事件窗口。

Result: 在仅腕部相机的RLBench任务上，正常光照下比RGB和RGB+event基线分别高20.6和12.0个百分点，严重曝光下降时高14.6和11.3个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的RGB方法。真实世界腕部事件相机实验在标称与极暗光照下均优于RGB-only与RGB+event基线。

Conclusion: 通过事件驱动的时空上下文建模，ECHO有效缓解了腕部事件相机的视野局限与极端曝光退化问题，在仿真和真实场景中均取得显著优于RGB及RGB+event基线的性能，验证了事件增强世界动作模型的可行性。

Abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.

</details>


### [351] [LVMT: Video Mask Transformer for Long-term Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34895)
*Narges Norouzi,Niccol`o Cavagnero,Idil Esen Zulfikar,Bastian Leibe,Gijs Dubbelman,Daan de Geus*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LVMT，通过轻量GRU时序传播模块与截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略，解决了长视频分割中的长期遮挡与长时序训练难题，在六个基准上取得新SOTA，且比前SOTA快10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线视频分割方法难以在长且复杂的视频中跟踪目标，尤其是存在长期遮挡时。作者将其归因于两点：(i) 时序传播机制无法自适应选择跨时间传播的目标信息；(ii) 受显存需求与梯度消失限制，无法在长视频上训练。

Method: 1) 提出轻量级GRU时序传播模块，可学习选择保留在记忆中的信息并跨时间传播；2) 提出截断查询传播（TQP）训练策略，将视频分块处理，块间传播被跟踪目标信息，但反向传播仅在单个块内进行，从而在不爆显存、无推理开销、无梯度消失的前提下实现更长的时序监督。整体模型称为Long-term Video Mask Transformer（LVMT）。

Result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，LVMT在一系列视频分割任务上刷新了SOTA，同时保持了其所基于的高效模型的速度，比前SOTA快10倍。

Conclusion: 通过自适应记忆选择与截断式长时序训练，LVMT有效提升了长视频目标跟踪与分割能力，兼具高精度与高效率。

Abstract: Existing online video segmentation methods struggle to track objects in long, complex videos with long-term occlusions. We hypothesize that this limitation is caused by (i) the inability of their temporal propagation mechanism to adaptively select the object information that is propagated across time, and (ii) their inability to be trained on long videos due to memory requirements and vanishing gradients. To address the first limitation, we propose to use a lightweight GRU-based temporal propagation module that can learn to select which information it keeps in memory and propagates across time. Second, to allow training on long videos, we introduce Truncated Query Propagation (TQP), a training strategy in which the model processes a video in chunks of frames, where information about tracked objects is propagated between chunks but backpropagation is only conducted in individual chunks, enabling longer temporal supervision without out-of-memory issues, inference overhead, or vanishing gradients. The resulting model is called the Long-term Video Mask Transformer (LVMT). Extensive experiments on six benchmarks show that LVMT sets a new state of the art across a range of video segmentation tasks, while retaining the speed of the highly efficient model it is based on, making it 10X faster than the prior state of the art. Code: https://www.tue-mps.org/lvmt

</details>


### [352] [Role-Guided MOE for Encoder-Level Pathology Representation Learning in WSI Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34897)
*Xinyu Ma,Xing Yang,Hongtao Jin,Guoquan Zhang,Shijie Zhang,Yu Zhang,Xitong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出病理角色引导的MoE-FFN框架，通过两阶段训练实现高效编码器级表征学习，在BRACS等数据集上稳定超越最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理基础模型作为冻结特征提取器时，固定编码器难以适配目标特异组织模式与判别线索；微调虽可提升适配性，却在数据稀缺场景下存在病理表征能力与适配效率的权衡。

Method: 构建角色引导MoE-FFN，在选定高层Transformer层引入MoE-FFN模块以提供异质病理模式的变换多样性。第一阶段源域专家初始化：从冻结Virchow2教师蒸馏病理先验到轻量DINOv2-small学生，并以角色原型作为弱病理锚点促进专家功能分化；第二阶段目标域适配：以非对称原型引导优化精炼专家，增强任务相关正证据并分离易混难负样本。

Result: 在公开BRACS数据集与私有PAROTID WSI数据集上，于五种代表性骨干网络中均取得相对最强基线的一致提升。

Conclusion: 该框架生成的编码器可离线提取patch表征，并直接对接标准MIL聚合器，兼顾病理特异性表征能力与适配效率。

Abstract: Whole slide image classification is a fundamental task in computational pathology, where patch representation quality directly affects downstream aggregation and slide-level discriminability. Pathology foundation models are widely adopted as frozen feature extractors for WSI classification; however, their fixed encoders may produce representations insufficiently adapted to target-specific tissue patterns and discriminative cues. Fine-tuning can improve target adaptation, but introduces a trade-off between pathology-specific representation capacity and adaptation efficiency, particularly in data-scarce settings. To address this, we propose a pathology role-guided mixture-of-experts feed-forward network (MoE-FFN) framework for efficient encoder-level representation learning. We design a two-stage training paradigm to establish and adapt pathology-aware expert specialization. In source-domain expert initialization, pathology-specific priors are distilled from a frozen Virchow2 teacher into a lightweight DINOv2-small student, while role prototypes serve as weak pathological anchors to encourage distinct expert functions. MoE-FFN blocks are introduced into selected high-level transformer layers to provide transformation diversity for heterogeneous pathological patterns. In target-domain adaptation, the initialized experts are refined through asymmetric prototype-guided optimization, enhancing task-relevant positive evidence and separating confusable hard negatives. The resulting encoder extracts offline patch representations that can be directly integrated with standard MIL aggregators. Experiments on the public BRACS dataset and a private PAROTID WSI dataset across five representative backbones demonstrate consistent improvements over the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [353] [FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34900)
*Hongjie Li,Xinran Yang,Xiuchao Wu,Jiangjing Lyu,Chengfei Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Filigree3D：基于稀疏潜在流匹配的图生3D框架，实现最高2048³（可扩展至4096³）体素分辨率的几何生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将图生3D生成扩展至超高分辨率时，计算成本急剧增长，而现有方法难以在不牺牲精细几何细节的前提下控制开销，因此需要兼顾效率与细节保真的方案。

Method: 提出稀疏潜在流匹配框架Filigree3D。核心技术包括：结构感知稀疏缩放（结合空间约束与交替局部-全局注意力，抑制token增长并保留细节与长程结构）；基于高分辨率几何增益筛选训练样本，并向稀疏3D DiT注入多尺度图像特征以耦合结构语义与细粒度视觉线索；可见性感知的体素正则化，提升对稀疏扰动的鲁棒性并补全未观测几何。

Result: 在默认配置下峰值GPU显存保持在当代硬件实用范围内，约一分钟即可生成高度复杂的三维几何；大量实验表明在整体几何保真度与精细细节保持上相较现有基线有显著提升。

Conclusion: 验证了在空前分辨率下实用且细节保真的3D生成可行性，并具备向4096³扩展的能力。

Abstract: Scaling image-to-3D generation to ultra-high resolutions requires controlling rapidly growing computational costs without sacrificing fine geometric detail. We present \textbf{Filigree3D}, a sparse latent flow-matching framework that generates 3D geometry from a single image at voxel resolutions up to $2048^3$, with straightforward extensibility to $4096^3$. To make training tractable, we introduce Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling, which combines spatial bounding with alternating local-global attention to constrain token growth while preserving both fine-scale details and long-range structural context. To enhance detail reconstruction, we curate training samples based on their high-resolution geometric gains and inject multi-scale image features into a sparse 3D DiT, effectively coupling structural semantics with fine-grained visual cues. Furthermore, a visibility-aware voxel regularization strategy improves robustness against sparse perturbations and facilitates the completion of unobserved geometry. Under our default configuration, Filigree3D maintains peak GPU memory consumption within practical limits for contemporary hardware, enabling the generation of highly intricate 3D geometry in approximately one minute. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method yields substantial improvements in overall geometric fidelity and fine-detail preservation compared to existing baselines, validating practical, detail-preserving 3D generation at unprecedented resolutions.

</details>


### [354] [ReSight-SMC: Two-Stage Power Sampling via Island SMC with Visual Scouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34905)
*Yaowen Zhang,Xiangyu Qiu,Junyi Hu,Zhi Lu,Wenwen Tian,Aoqin Wang,Junhai Luo,Zhenming Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ReSight-SMC，一种无验证器的两阶段 power sampler，用于 LVLM 推理，通过祖先隔离 SMC 岛与视觉 scout 路由，以及按规范答案聚合末端重要性质量，提升有限粒子预算下的多模态推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Power sampling 在 LLM 推理中已表现出媲美强化学习的训练-free 能力，但在大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中仍缺乏探索。将 Power-SMC 直接迁移到 LVLM 解码虽可作为强基线，却存在两个未解决问题：粒子层面，全局重采样会导致 genealogy 坍塌，且基于粒子的 power sampling 未通过不同视觉线索多样化轨迹，限制了有限粒子预算下的探索；答案层面，序列级 sharpening 使支持同一答案的不同推理轨迹相互竞争。

Method: 提出 ReSight-SMC，一种无验证器的两阶段 power sampler。第一阶段采用 ancestry-isolated SMC islands 保留独立轨迹族，并将有界数量的 prefix-conditioned visual scouts 路由到与前缀相关的图像区域，同时抑制冗余重叠；每个 scout 临时增强对图像 token 的注意力并强调其路由区域。通过精确重要性校正保持基础 LVLM 的 sequence-power 目标。第二阶段按规范答案聚合末端重要性质量，对答案边缘分布进行幂次化，并采样一个答案及支持该答案的轨迹。

Result: 在四个 LVLM 骨干和五个基准上，ReSight-SMC 在推理与感知基准组上的聚合性能均强于 Power-SMC。在无后训练情况下，其聚合表现与使用强化学习训练的对应骨干模型保持竞争力。

Conclusion: ReSight-SMC 通过粒子级祖先隔离与视觉 scout 路由、答案级边缘聚合，有效缓解了有限粒子多模态推理中的探索不足与轨迹竞争问题，作为训练-free 方法在 LVLM 推理上取得了优于 Power-SMC 的表现，并接近 RL 训练模型的水平。

Abstract: Power sampling has emerged as a training-free approach to LLM reasoning, eliciting capabilities comparable to reinforcement learning by sharpening the model distribution over complete responses. Despite this success, power sampling remains underexplored in large vision-language models (LVLMs). We transfer Power-SMC to LVLM decoding by defining a sequence-power target conditioned on both the image and the prompt. This direct transfer provides a strong training-free baseline, but leaves two aspects of finite-particle multimodal inference unaddressed. At the particle level, global resampling can collapse genealogies, while particle-based power sampling does not diversify trajectories through distinct visual cues in multimodal decoding, limiting exploration under a finite particle budget. At the answer level, sequence-level sharpening makes distinct reasoning trajectories compete even when they support the same answer. We introduce ReSight-SMC, a verifier-free two-stage power sampler for LVLM inference. Its first stage uses ancestry-isolated SMC islands to preserve independent trajectory families and routes a bounded set of prefix-conditioned visual scouts to prefix-relevant image regions while discouraging redundant overlap. Each scout temporarily increases attention to the image tokens and emphasizes its routed region. Exact importance correction preserves the base LVLM sequence-power target. The second stage aggregates terminal importance mass by canonical answer, powers the answer marginal, and samples an answer together with a supporting trajectory. Across four LVLM backbones and five benchmarks, ReSight-SMC achieves stronger aggregate performance than Power-SMC over both the reasoning and perception benchmark groups. Without post-training, it remains competitive in aggregate with backbone-matched models trained using reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [355] [TaoTex: Boosting Texture Detail Fidelity for Native 3D Material Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34934)
*Xiuchao Wu,Shuichang Lai,Jiangjing Lyu,Chengfei Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散的3D材质生成模型TaoTex，通过数据构建、多层级特征融合与潜空间到像素空间损失转换等策略，显著提升3D资产纹理细节的重建保真度，并支持单视图与多视图输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D生成模型虽能生成准确几何，但难以重建细致纹理；同时公开数据集缺乏高频纹理资产，导致模型对文本、图案等挑战性细节恢复能力不足，且VAE重建误差影响像素级质量。

Method: 1) 设计数据构建代理生成高频纹理3D资产以弥补数据缺口；2) 提出多层级特征融合模块（MLFF）自适应融合条件输入的局部与全局特征，为扩散模型提供更完整纹理线索；3) 采用潜空间到像素空间的损失转换以缓解VAE重建误差；4) 通过引入可学习视角嵌入将模型扩展至多视图输入，实现跨视图一致材质重建。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在单视图与多视图设置下，在保留纹理细节方面均显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: TaoTex通过数据增强、特征融合、损失转换与多视图扩展，有效解决了3D材质生成中纹理细节恢复难题，验证了所提策略对提升生成保真度的有效性。

Abstract: Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements. First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.

</details>


### [356] [Resolution as a First-Class Decision: Task-Conditioned Routing for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34942)
*Zhiqiang Xia,Yang Li,Xinyuan Zhang,Yuchen Liu,Haoyu Lu,Jiaming Xu,Runyu Shi,Ying Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出任务条件化分辨率路由（TCRR），将视觉压缩建模为任务条件决策，用轻量跨模态路由器预测每条查询的最小充分压缩级别，从而在不改动 MLLM 主干的前提下大幅降低视觉计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM 推理效率受高分辨率输入带来的海量视觉 token 严重制约，计算成本随 token 数呈二次增长。现有方法多集中于下游 token 压缩，而忽略了上游的根本性低效：输入分辨率被当作静态的、与任务无关的超参数，无法按查询需求自适应调整。

Method: 提出 Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing（TCRR），将视觉压缩表述为任务条件化决策。采用轻量跨模态路由器，通过特征级调制（feature-wise modulation）与交叉注意力，以文本语义为条件调节主干视觉表示，为每条查询预测最小充分压缩级别。同时构建覆盖 12 类任务、50 万样本的数据集，经 teacher-oracle 流程标注以近似 Pareto 最优压缩尺度。

Result: 在多种架构上的大量实验表明，TCRR 取得更优的效率前沿：在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上视觉 FLOPs 降低 40.9%，延迟降低 53.7%，同时保持有竞争力的性能。缩放行为分析进一步证实，动态路由视觉压缩可在不修改 MLLM 主干的情况下实现最优资源分配。

Conclusion: 将视觉压缩从静态超参数转变为任务条件化的动态路由决策，可在保持性能的前提下显著提升 MLLM 推理效率，且无需改动 MLLM 主干，具备良好的架构通用性与资源分配灵活性。

Abstract: The inference efficiency of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is severely constrained by massive visual token sequences induced by high-resolution inputs, with computational cost scaling quadratically. Existing approaches primarily focus on downstream token compression, while overlooking a fundamental upstream inefficiency: input resolution is treated as a static, task-agnostic hyperparameter. We propose Task-Conditioned Resolution Routing (TCRR), which formulates visual compression as a task-conditioned decision and employs a lightweight cross-modal router that conditions backbone visual representations on textual semantics via feature-wise modulation and cross-attention to predict the minimal sufficient compression level per query. To support this, we curate a dataset of 500k samples across 12 task categories, labeled via a teacher-oracle pipeline to approximate Pareto-optimal compression scales. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures show that TCRR achieves a superior efficiency frontier, specifically reducing visual FLOPs by 40.9% and latency by 53.7% on Qwen3-VL-8B while preserving competitive performance. Further analysis of scaling behavior confirms that dynamically routing visual compression enables optimal resource allocation without modifying the MLLM backbone.

</details>


### [357] [Just MLPs: Efficient Visual State Reconstruction for Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34972)
*Jingdi lei,Junxian Li,Di Zhang,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出δ-Vision，用轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆，替代视觉token在Transformer中的反复演化，在保留全部视觉token的前提下降低MLLM计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型中长视觉token序列占据大量计算开销，现有方法通过剪枝冗余视觉token来降低成本，但会永久丢弃后续层可能需要的视觉证据。因此作者希望探索能否在保留全部视觉token的同时，减少其在Transformer中反复演化表示的成本。

Method: 对视觉到文本的信息流进行低秩干预：发现当视觉到文本注意力被阻断后，仅恢复少数方向即可找回大部分精度损失，说明相关视觉影响集中在低维子空间；同时发现逐层视觉状态具有强可预测性，轻量MLP能以高余弦相似度和低重构误差近似。基于此提出δ-Vision，用轻量低秩适配器构建逐层视觉记忆，替代视觉token的重复Transformer演化，同时保留全部视觉token供文本检索。

Result: 在图像和视频基准上，δ-Vision在相当或更低计算量下取得了高于视觉token剪枝基线的准确率，同时在不丢弃视觉token的情况下提供了有竞争力的推理效率。

Conclusion: 视觉影响集中于低维子空间且逐层视觉状态高度可预测，因此可在保留全部视觉token的同时用低秩适配器替代重复演化，从而兼顾准确率与效率，避免剪枝带来的证据永久丢失。

Abstract: Long visual token sequences often account for a substantial fraction of the computational overhead in multimodal large language models~(MLLMs). Existing approaches reduce this cost by pruning redundant visual tokens, but permanently discard visual evidence that may become useful in subsequent layers. We instead ask whether all visual tokens can be preserved while reducing the cost of repeatedly evolving the representations through the Transformer. To answer this question, we perform low-rank interventions on visual-to-text information flow. We find that, after visual-to-text attention is blocked, restoring only a few directions recovers most of the lost accuracy, suggesting the relevant visual influence is concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace. We further observe strong predictability in layer-specific visual states: lightweight MLPs approximate them with high cosine similarity and low reconstruction error. Motivated by these findings, we propose $δ$-Vision, which replaces repeated Transformer evolution of visual tokens with lightweight low-rank adapters that construct layer-wise visual memories while preserving all visual tokens for text retrieval. Across image and video benchmarks, $δ$-Vision achieves higher accuracy than visual token pruning baselines at comparable or lower computation, while delivering competitive inference efficiency without discarding visual tokens.

</details>


### [358] [SPIDER: Multi-Layer Semantic Token Pruning and Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34977)
*Tianxiang Chen,Zhentao Tan,Zi Ye,Yue Wu,Xiaobing Tu,Jinkui Ren,Xiantao Zhang,Tao Gong,Qi Chu,Nenghai Yu,Xipeng Qiu,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出SPIDER，一个免训练框架，通过多层语义视觉token剪枝与自适应子层跳过机制，同时应对多模态大模型中的数据冗余与计算冗余，在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上减少79% FLOPs并保留96%基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型存在源于数据冗余与计算冗余的效率挑战，二者相互耦合。现有方法多聚焦于从视觉编码器输出剪枝视觉token，或基于块级重要性在LLM解码器中处理计算冗余，但层间表示漂移与层内分布差异尚未被充分探索。

Method: 作者提出应从视觉编码器的中间层token进行有效视觉token剪枝，因为语义焦点随层数变化，中间层token包含更细致的以物体为中心的信息，而深层可能将其抽象化。同时揭示了不同LLM解码器层中Attention与FFN的差异化贡献。据此提出免训练框架SPIDER，整合多层语义视觉token剪枝（SPI）与自适应子层跳过机制（DER）。

Result: 实验表明SPIDER在多种MLLM架构和不同压缩比下均能保持强劲性能。例如在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上，SPIDER减少79% FLOPs，同时保持96%的基线性能。

Conclusion: SPIDER通过联合处理数据冗余与计算冗余的双层低效问题，验证了中间层语义剪枝与子层自适应跳过的有效性，是一种免训练、可泛化且高效的多模态大模型加速方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose \textbf{SPIDER}, a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer \underline{\textbf{S}}emantic visual token \underline{\textbf{P}}run\underline{\textbf{I}}ng with an a\underline{\textbf{D}}aptive sub-lay\underline{\textbf{ER}} skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by $79\%$ while maintaining 96$\%$ of the baseline performance.

</details>


### [359] [One Sensor, Whole Body - 3D Body Pose from a Single Consumer Earbud IMU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34978)
*Zhilin Guo,Boqiao Zhang,Oszkár Urbán,Josef Bengtson,Hakan Aktas,Wenzhao Li,Siyu Hong,Kyle Fogarty,Chenliang Zhou,Ali Senguel,Cengiz Oztireli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了同步四视角RGB-D与AirPods头部IMU、双鞋垫IMU的多模态采集流水线，生成35条单被试基准，验证单一头部IMU即可恢复下肢体位（79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE）与足部接地（0.809 macro-F1），而增加消费级足部IMU并不显著提升甚至有时劣化精度，表明传感器可靠性而非数量才是约束瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 消费级耳机（如AirPods）已能输出头部惯性运动数据，是人体佩戴最广泛的传感器位置之一。作者希望探究：单个头部IMU能恢复多少三维人体姿态，以及增加更多消费级传感器是否真正有益。

Method: 搭建多模态采集流水线，同步记录四视角RGB-D视频、AirPods头部IMU与两个Striv鞋垫IMU，事后对齐流并用SAM 3D Body生成伪真值，得到覆盖步态、转向、垂直、日常及临床启发动作的35条单被试基准。适配两类循环模型（IMUPoser与MobilePoser），并构建因果变体以评估流式延迟下的精度；通过配对逐条显著性检验、佩戴偏置探针与仅足部消融定位机制；再将输出扩展至20关节全身骨架并采用分阶段微调。

Result: 单个头部IMU可恢复下肢体位（79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE）与逐脚接地（0.809 macro-F1），因果变体在流式延迟下保留大部分精度。配对显著性检验显示，加入消费级足部IMU从未显著提升姿态，且在四种模型-划分组合中的两种显著劣化；佩戴偏置探针与仅足部消融表明机制在于鞋垫朝向质量而非足部位置。扩展至20关节全身骨架时，仅凭头部可部分恢复远端手臂大幅运动，但无法恢复近端上半身姿态；分阶段微调可挽回朴素联合训练因多任务稀释而损失的腿部精度。

Conclusion: 对于消费级可穿戴设备的学习式姿态估计，传感器可靠性而非数量是当前的绑定约束；在所测试的设备中，耳机处于其最佳平衡点（sweet spot）。

Abstract: Consumer earbuds already stream inertial motion data from the head, one of the most widely worn sensor locations on the body. We ask how much of the 3D body pose a single such head IMU can recover, and whether adding more consumer sensors actually helps. We build a multimodal capture pipeline that records four-view RGB-D video together with an AirPods head IMU and two Striv insole IMUs, synchronize the streams post-hoc, and generate pseudo-ground-truth with SAM 3D Body, yielding a 35-take single-subject benchmark spanning gait, turning, vertical, everyday, and clinically inspired motions. Adapting two recurrent model families (IMUPoser and MobilePoser), we show that one head IMU recovers lower-body pose at 79.0 mm rigid-MPJPE and per-foot ground contact at 0.809 macro-F1, and that a causal variant retains most of this accuracy at streaming latency. In paired per-take significance tests across both families, adding the consumer foot IMUs never significantly improves pose and significantly degrades it in two of four model-split combinations; a mounting-bias probe and feet-only ablation identify insole orientation quality, not foot placement, as the mechanism. Extending the output to a 20-joint full-body skeleton maps the boundary: gross distal-arm motion is partially recoverable from the head alone, proximal upper-body pose is not, and staged fine-tuning recovers the leg accuracy that naive joint training sacrifices to multi-task dilution. For learned pose from consumer wearables, sensor reliability, not sensor count, is the binding constraint here. For the devices tested, the earbud is its sweet spot. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhilinGuo/one-sensor-whole-body.

</details>


### [360] [What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34981)
*Renping Zhou,Zanlin Ni,Zihao Fan,Guohao Fu,Zeyu Liu,Hao Shi,Jie Zhang,Chi Bene Chen,Yang Yue,Xueyang Fu,Gao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究世界动作模型(WAM)推理阶段是否需要生成未来帧，发现隐式WAM虽在分布内任务表现相当，却丧失了泛化优势；关键收益来自第一个去噪步的"未来准备"而非"未来生成"，据此提出Simple-WAM，仅用一次全噪声视频token前向传播并调整训练噪声调度，兼顾显式WAM的泛化性与隐式WAM的效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAM在训练时同时预测未来与动作，但视频去噪计算开销大，导致推理时是否仍需生成未来存在争议：显式WAM逐块去噪生成清晰帧，隐式WAM则完全丢弃未来以加速。作者质疑隐式WAM是否保留了促使WAM提出的泛化优势。

Method: 在匹配骨干网络、训练数据与算力预算的受控条件下，从环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三个维度对比显式与隐式WAM；分析泛化差距的来源（定位到第一个去噪步）；提出Simple-WAM：将未来建模简化为对完全加噪视频token的单次前向传播，并使训练噪声调度适配该推理行为。

Result: 当动作专家不再以未来表征为条件时，三个泛化维度均出现一致退化；泛化差距几乎完全来自第一个去噪步，收益源于"准备未来"而非"生成未来"；Simple-WAM在仿真与真实任务中同时取得显式WAM的泛化性能和与隐式WAM相当的效率。

Conclusion: 推理阶段无需真正生成未来视频，仅需让动作专家在单次前向中条件于全噪声未来token即可保留泛化收益；Simple-WAM以极低开销实现了显式与隐式WAM优势的统一。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}

</details>


### [361] [ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34982)
*Di Zhu,Ziheng Yan,Fang Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ActionUNet：一种高效多尺度微调框架，通过在时序对齐的动作特征空间中构建轻量级时序U-Net融合层次结构先验，并采用带二阶平滑约束的条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，以极低计算成本增强预训练VLA模型，显著提升操作成功率与时序连续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型将多模态语义映射为物理动作，但难以将粗粒度语义与细粒度时序执行对齐，导致其在杂乱环境中的泛化能力有限、鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出ActionUNet多尺度微调框架：1）在时序对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量级时序U-Net，融合层次化结构先验，弥合语义与执行之间的尺度鸿沟；2）针对多尺度建模破坏微观时序连续性、引起机械振荡的问题，采用条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，引入显式二阶平滑约束，保证时序连续性并抑制高频抖动。

Result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus及真实世界困难评测中，π0.5成功率分别绝对提升9.8%、6.1%、11.4%；并可泛化至基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT骨干。

Conclusion: ActionUNet以低计算成本有效提升VLA模型的时序执行质量、泛化性与操作鲁棒性，验证了其作为一种高效微调策略的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

</details>


### [362] [Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35002)
*Qiankun Li,Yuechen Zhang,Bowen Chen,Shilinlu Yan,Zhenhong Zhou,Kun Wang,Li Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将压缩诱发的对抗风险定义为配对失败归因问题，提出压缩特异性失败（CSF）概念与CIRA攻击方法，在受限访问（无语言模型、无压缩器、无预算信息）下验证了视觉token压缩确实会引入独立于底层模型的风险，并给出配对评估范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉token压缩虽能降低LVLM推理成本，但现有聚合鲁棒性指标无法区分某一对抗失败究竟源自压缩本身还是继承自底层模型，导致压缩诱导的风险无法被准确归因。

Method: 提出CSF定义：全token推理正确、压缩后出错的对抗样本，将问题建模为配对失败归因。诊断实验用反事实分析证明保留集分配因果影响压缩正确性，并发现恢复率与位移证据的表征漂移负相关。据此提出CIRA：在视觉编码器白盒设定下，通过编码器侧目标优化图像扰动，跨候选压缩预算操纵token优先级并保留位移证据，无需下游问题、标签、语言模型、部署压缩器或确切预算。

Result: 在12个数据集-压缩器组合、4种预算下，CIRA平均CSFR达20.35%，而全token攻击成功率仅6.92%，在额外LVLM家族上表现类似。跨视图选择-稳定化防御可显著抑制CIRA，但自适应CIRA可部分恢复其效果。

Conclusion: 压缩特异性失败在受限访问条件下依然存在，说明压缩本身可独立引入对抗风险；支持采用全token与压缩推理的配对评估来归因视觉token压缩风险。

Abstract: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.

</details>


### [363] [Verifying the Linear Representation Hypothesis: How Interpretable Are Vision SAEs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35020)
*Teodor Chiaburu,Franz Motzkus,Frank Haußer,Felix Bießmann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过将Autointerpretability Score适配到视觉任务并开展用户研究，实证表明现有视觉SAE可解释性指标（无论是否基于线性表示假设）之间互不相关，也无法反映人类感知，因此单一无参考指标不足以验证SAE可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉稀疏自编码器（SAE）在机制可解释性中被广泛采用，其核心前提是线性表示假设（LRH），即多义特征可投影到稀疏、人类可理解的正交表示基上。然而现有评估框架多测量代理指标（如SAE特征的稀疏性或所推断词典的一致性），并隐含假设这些指标能反映与人类感知的对齐。本文旨在检验这一假设是否成立，论证SAE概念可解释性的度量比这些代理指标所暗示的更为困难。

Method: 作者将此前在自然语言处理中被证明与人类判断一致的Autointerpretability Score（AIS）适配到视觉任务，并通过专门的用户研究验证该适配方法。随后使用标准指标与适配后的AIS两类方法评估SAE概念质量，考察各指标之间以及与AIS之间的相关性。

Result: 实验发现，既有的SAE可解释性指标之间互不相关，且与AIS也不相关。这表明无论指标是否基于线性表示假设（LRH），没有任何单一的无参考（reference-free）指标足以验证视觉SAE的可解释性。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持近期关于解释方法应更具可验证性、并以真值（ground-truth）为锚进行设计与评估的呼吁，提示视觉SAE可解释性评估需要超越现有代理指标的更可靠范式。

Abstract: Vision Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have become a popular tool in Mechanistic Interpretability due to their presumed ability to disentangle complex features learned by a model into monosemantic concepts. Despite their growing popularity, evaluating their interpretability remains an active topic of research. The bedrock motivating the adoption of SAEs is the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which claims that polysemantic features can be projected onto a (near) orthogonal basis of sparse, human-understandable representations. Yet, most current frameworks evaluate proxies such as the sparsity of SAE features or the coherence of the inferred dictionary, implicitly assuming that these reflect alignment with human perception. In this paper, we provide empirical evidence that measuring the interpretability of SAE concepts is more difficult than these proxies suggest. To this end, we adapt the Autointerpretability Score (AIS) - previously shown to align with human judgments in Natural Language Processing - to vision tasks and validate our approach in a dedicated user study. We evaluate SAE concept quality using both standard metrics and our adapted AIS. We find that established interpretability metrics for SAEs correlate neither with one another nor with AIS, indicating that no single reference-free metric, whether grounded in the LRH or not, is sufficient for verifying the interpretability of vision SAEs. We argue these findings support recent calls for more verifiable, ground-truth-anchored design and evaluation of explanation methods.

</details>


### [364] [Detection of Adversarial Attacks on Super-Resolvers Using Spectral Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35022)
*Emma J. Reid,Haley Duba-Sullivan,Tony G. Allen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于频谱的检测方法，使用径向平均功率谱密度作为判别特征训练XGBoost检测器，用于识别超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击，并在多种训练与跨架构场景下优于幅度和相位频谱检测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将深度学习模型集成到图像预处理流水线（如超分辨率）中，为对抗者攻击下游任务引入了尚未充分探索的攻击面。为保证关键成像流水线的可信性，需要能够检测预处理模型内部的对抗行为。

Method: 以径向平均功率谱密度（radially-averaged power spectral density）作为判别特征，训练极端梯度提升（XGBoost）检测器，用于检测超分辨率网络中的模型级威胁；并与基于幅度和相位的傅里叶频谱检测器进行基准对比，在多种训练场景和跨架构场景下评估各方法。

Result: 所提检测器在大多数场景下优于对比检测器；结果表明高频特征对于跨SR架构检测AdvSR攻击最具信息量。

Conclusion: 基于径向平均功率谱密度的XGBoost检测器可有效识别超分辨率模型权重中的对抗攻击，且高频频谱特征在跨架构检测中最为关键，为成像流水线预处理模型的信任保障提供了可行途径。

Abstract: The integration of deep learning models into image preprocessing pipelines such as super-resolution introduces a largely unexplored attack vector for adversaries targeting downstream tasks. To ensure trustworthiness of critical imaging pipelines, we must be able to detect adversarial behavior within preprocessing models. In this paper, we propose a spectral-based detection method for identifying adversarial attacks embedded in super-resolution model weights. More specifically, we use the radially-averaged power spectral density as a discriminative feature to train an extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) detector, demonstrating detectability of model-level threats in super-resolution networks. We further benchmark our detector against magnitude- and phase-based Fourier spectrum detectors, evaluating each method across a range of training and cross-architecture scenarios.
